.<lg n="5"><l n="a">dināvāṅ* rāt teja hyaṅ aruṇa sumunviṅ girivana,</l>
.<l n="b">kidaṅnyāmaṅsul riṅ gəgər avurahan və̄knya malayū,</l>
890<l n="c">byatītādan saṅ śrī nṛpasuta muvah saṅ yativara,</l>
.<l n="d">samāgyātūt lambuṅniṅ acala tumūt tan sah aṅiriṅ.</l>
. <!-- <app> * G. — 5a A. B. D. E. F. G. H. dināvaṅ.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
895
.</div>
.<div type="canto" rend="met" n="17" met="FILL-ME-IN">
.<lg n="1"><l n="a">tadanantareki ri larisnira ləṅəṅ aməgatməgat gunuṅ,</l>
.<l n="b">hana pājaran katəmu śūnya masəpi ri samīpaniṅ paruṅ,</l>
900<l n="c">mavalantagāraṅ* aputih śikharanika kayunya kāṅinan,</l>
.<l n="d">kuməlabkəlab kadi kəlabni tapih iṅ amarāṅganāṅlayaṅ.</l>
. <!-- <app> * B. C D. E. F. G. — 1c A. H. mavəlantāgaraṅ. B. aputih ri kayu nya. C. D. aputih ri śikara ni kayu nya.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
905<lg n="2"><l n="a">kusumāṅjrah iṅ natar aṅuṅkuli juraṅ alaṅə̄ kadīṅ tulis,</l>
.<l n="b">bhramarāṅrəṅ iṅ gaḍuṅ <app><lem>avarṇa</lem><rdg wit="#edss">avaṛṇna</rdg></app> manələhi siraṅ nṛpātmaja,</l>
.<l n="c">karuhun munīndra saṅ akahyaṅatiki <app><lem>sahaharṣagorava</lem><rdg wit="#edss">sahahaṛṣagorava</rdg></app> ,</l>
.<l n="d">bhagavān sumitra panəlahnira guruvana pakṣa sogata.</l>
. <!-- <app>2c D. G. H. akahyaṅan atiki.
910</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="3"><l n="a">vacanārya paṇḍita sabhāgya sira mihat i saṅ nṛpātmaja,</l>
.<l n="b">syapa teki liṅnira ri saṅ para ṛṣi sama masraṅādulur,*</l>
.<l n="c">sipi <app><lem>harṣa</lem><rdg wit="#edss">haṛṣa</rdg></app> ni ṅhulun i denira parama surūpa digjaya,</l>
915<l n="d">paramārtha sūkṣma maśarīra mətu ri səḍəṅ iṅ nirātmaka.</l>
. <!-- <app> * B. C. D. E. F. G. H. — 3b A. hasraṅādulur. — 3c C. nira marama.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="4"><l n="a">ṛṣi keśavāvasita sārjava mavarah i saṅ mahāmuni,</l>
920<l n="b">sutasoma sajñanira bhūpatisuta suta hastineśvara,</l>
.<l n="c">kavivān i dharmaśaraṇāguṇa paramahitādiśāstravān,</l>
.<l n="d">sakaleśvarāmbəkira tan hana siriṅan ireṅ jagaddhita.</l>
.</lg>
.<lg n="5"><l n="a">ya ta hetu saṅ prabhu mamarvata gəṅ i sih ireṅ nṛpātmaja,</l>
925<l n="b">taya len gumantya ri sirān tribhuvanapati katvaṅ iṅ jagat,</l>
.<l n="c">apitovi śākyamuni maṅdadi ri sira viśeṣa devata,</l>
.<l n="d">subhageki ṅūni ri vijilnira para sura bhaktyamūrchita.</l>
. <!-- <app>5d G. parama subhaktyamūrsita.
.</app> -->
930</lg>
.
.</div>
.<div type="canto" rend="met" n="18" met="FILL-ME-IN">
.<lg n="1"><l n="a">kunaṅ karana saṅ narendrasuta yan layat aṅənəs i himbaṅiṅ vukir,</l>
935<l n="b">marāməṅaməṅ iṅ tapovana sinādhya vihikana* ri saṅ mahāmuni,</l>
.<l n="c">muvah pinakamuṣṭiniṅ tvas aharəp vruh ri śikharaniṅ mahāgiri,</l>
.<l n="d">prayojana nimittaniṅ svatanu tan kahavarana madevatāśraya.</l>
. <!-- <app> * B. C. D. H. — 1b A. G. sinādhya ri vihikana. — 1d G. kahavara.
.</app> -->
940</lg>
.<lg n="2"><l n="a">nahan liṅira keśavājar i gatī nṛpasuta mahas aṅjajah laṅə̄,</l>
.<l n="b">siraṅ viku sumitra garjita mavākta* madhura ri siraṅ nṛpātmaja,</l>
.<l n="c">tuhanku bapa devaśṛddha ri hiḍəpkvi təkani tanayaṅkv ikiṅ vukir,</l>
.<l n="d">ri denta kurunāthavaṅśa putu <app><lem>liṅku</lem><rdg wit="#edss">liugku</rdg></app> kita saka ri saṅ nareśvarī.</l>
945 <!-- <app> * B. C. D. E. F. G. H. — 2b A. mavakta.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.
.</div>
950<div type="canto" rend="met" n="19" met="FILL-ME-IN">
.<lg n="1"><l n="a">sambandha saṅ śrī ravibhoja riṅ daṅu,</l>
.<l n="b">rvānaknira saṅ subalāgraja prabhu,</l>
.<l n="c">mvaṅ saṅ jayatsena pamuṅsu ya ṅhulun,</l>
.<l n="d">saṅkan raray* paṇḍitavṛttilakṣaṇa.</l>
955 <!-- <app> * B. C. D. E. F. G. H. — 1d A. rare.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="2"><l n="a">yekan* tinūtniṅ vanavāsabhikṣuka,</l>
.<l n="b">rākaṅku bhūpāla ri līnaniṅ bapa,</l>
960<l n="c">mānak rva sikyānakəbi lavan jalu,</l>
.<l n="d">saṅ candrasiṅhātuha puruṣottama.</l>
. <!-- <app> * B. C. D. E. F. H. — 2a A. G. yeka.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
965<lg n="3"><l n="a">prajñādharī stri pamuṅśu dugsiṅi,</l>
.<l n="b">kālap təkap hastinarājabhūpati,</l>
.<l n="c">yekā pakebuṅ nṛpaputra tan vaneh,</l>
.<l n="d">saṅ candrasiṅhāṅadəg iṅ svanāgara.</l>
. <!-- <app>3a F. prajñādharīstrīki. — 3c D. pakebu.
970</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="4"><l n="a">sampun pəjah maṅkana ratva riṅ puri,</l>
.<l n="b">rogi pva* deniṅ viṣa durjanāṅlare,</l>
.<l n="c">ndān ātmaja śrī naranātha bhūpati,</l>
975<l n="d">khyātīṅ sarāt saṅ daśabāhu śaktimān.</l>
. <!-- <app> * H. A. B. C. D. E. F. G. rogīya.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="5"><l n="a">vvantən vəkas saṅ daśabāhu kanyakā,</l>
980<l n="b">dyah candravatyārəja nāma putrikā,</l>
.<l n="c">yogyān savāve kita bhaktya riṅ jinəm,</l>
.<l n="d">pan vvaṅ sanak saṅ nṛpaputra tan madoh.</l>
. <!-- <app>5a D. E. vəka.
.</app> -->
985</lg>
.<lg n="6"><l n="a">nāhan vuvus saṅ yati riṅ nṛpātmaja,</l>
.<l n="b">tuṣṭottamāmbək sutasoma garjita,</l>
.<l n="c">yekān sirānəmbah i jə̄ṅ munīśvara,</l>
.<l n="d">somyātutur bhaktinirān makavvitan.</l>
990</lg>
.<lg n="7"><l n="a">malvī sirāminta ri sihni saṅ kaki,</l>
.<l n="b">aptyā ruməṅva prabhu dhātrajādhika,</l>
.<l n="c">doniṅ mahāvīra jagatparāśraya,</l>
.<l n="d">śaktyādbhutāgə̄ṅ daśabāhu riṅ laga.</l>
995</lg>
.<lg n="8"><l n="a">oṁ saṅ narendrātmaja mājara ṅhulun,</l>
.<l n="b">tiṅkahnikaṅ dhātrasutendra digjaya,</l>
.<l n="c">śrī candrasiṅhā tiki ṅūni pūrvaka,</l>
.<l n="d">nāpatya duhkhan sira sah sakeṅ pura.</l>
1000</lg>
.<lg n="9"><l n="a">saṅ revatī strīnira satya subrata,</l>
.<l n="b">rovaṅniraṅ luṅha musir vanāntara,</l>
.<l n="c">putrārja pinrihnira dhīra riṅ raṇa,</l>
.<l n="d">sūkṣmā tadin rājya ri tan vruh iṅ bala.</l>
1005</lg>
.<lg n="10"><l n="a">prāpteṅ vukir pañcapatīrthan uttama,</l>
.<l n="b">dhyāyī sire madhyanika ndātan bəsur,</l>
.<l n="c">akveh mahābañcana tan sinaṅśaya,</l>
.<l n="d">vvil bhūta jə̄ṅ mastaka rodra kātara.</l>
1010</lg>
.<lg n="11"><l n="a">kīrṇaṅ kavaṇḍāṅidəri nareśvara,</l>
.<l n="b">sthīrān pagəh buddhinirān mamet hayu,</l>
.<l n="c">aig* rəp turun hyaṅ vidhi ghora gə̄ṅ galak,</l>
.<l n="d">sarvāstra yekan daśabāhurūpaka.</l>
1015 <!-- <app> * D. H. — 11b D. E. H. sthīrāpagəh. — A. B. C. E. F. G. ait.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="12"><l n="a">śīghrān təkānambut i saṅ nareśvara,</l>
.<l n="b">lvir kadyaṅulvā naranātha tar vihaṅ,</l>
1020<l n="c">śrī revatī glāna kavəs mihat sira,</l>
.<l n="d">yekānaṅis makrak aminta jīvana.</l>
. <!-- <app>12a D. təkānambut.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
1025
.</div>
.<div type="canto" rend="met" n="20" met="FILL-ME-IN">
.<lg n="1"><l n="a">vəkasan atiki saṅ hyaṅ somyāvəlas ri narapati,</l>
.<l n="b">rika tumuluya śabdāstvāsūnvā kamu subala,</l>
1030<l n="c">tuvin atiśaya riṅ rāt śaktīṅ praṅ jaya suyaśa,</l>
.<l n="d">liṅ ira təhər amūkṣān tuṣṭāmbək bhuvanapati.</l>
. <!-- <app>1b B. G. D. E. F. H. tumuluyanabdāstvāsūnvā.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
1035<lg n="2"><l n="a">karaṇaniran umantuk riṅ rājyāmagəh i pura,</l>
.<l n="b">rahina vəṅi maṅekadhyāyī hyaṅ smara pinupul,</l>
.<l n="c">dumadak amahi rəsrəs rəsrəs śrī nṛpamahiṣī,</l>
.<l n="d">tan arən avədi kāṅən rūpa hyaṅ vidhi kasusu.</l>
.</lg>
1040<lg n="3"><l n="a">ri paṅidamira maṅkin tan māryāsəmu gigirən,</l>
.<l n="b">lalu divaśa mijil taṅ rārayādbhuta tan ahajə̄ṅ,</l>
.<l n="c">kagirigiri daśabāhvānak śrī nṛpamahiṣī,</l>
.<l n="d">pravala kadi vijil* hyaṅ durvaktran saka riṅ ibu.</l>
. <!-- <app> * C. D. E. — 3d A. B. F. G. H. mijil.
1045</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="4"><l n="a">salihatira sudevī riṅ putrāgila* malayu,</l>
.<l n="b">sahanahananikaṅ strī kapvārəs mihat i sira,</l>
.<l n="c">nṛpati sira mənəṅ tan pojar majəṅər i hati,</l>
1050<l n="d">manəsəl i gatiniṅ tan tiṅkahniṅ mapatutana.**</l>
. <!-- <app>* B. C. D. E. F. G. ** D. E. G. H. — 4a A. H. putrāsiga. — 4d A. B. C. F. mapahutana.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="5"><l n="a">irika nṛpati motus riṅ vīrāṅañutaṅ anak,</l>
1055<l n="b">labuhən i tələṅ iṅ lod vetniṅ tan sukha mihata,*</l>
.<l n="c">vahu ta sira sinambut ləs mūkṣāmarəṅi kəḍap,</l>
.<l n="d">ri valuyira hilaṅ taṅ hastākveh smara sadṛśa.**</l>
. <!-- <app>* C. D. E. F. G. H. ** B. C. D. E. G. — 5b A. B. mihati. — 5d A. F. H. sadṛsa.
.</app> -->
1060</lg>
.<lg n="6"><l n="a">sahapatər adulur mvaṅ liṇḍū gə̄ṅ prabhavanira,</l>
.<l n="b">kusuma ravuh ikā saṅkeṅ <app><lem>byomāṅibəki</lem><rdg wit="#edss">bhyomāṅibəki</rdg></app> pura,</l>
.<l n="c">suravacana humuṅ brahmājānindita karəṅə̄,</l>
.<l n="d">tinut iṅaranirān saṅ brahmājān pinagəhakən.</l>
1065 <!-- <app>6a C. D. lindvāgə̄ṅ. — 6d C. brahmājān. E. pinagəhan.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="7"><l n="a">atha ri hilaṅ ikaṅ rūpādbhute nṛpatisuta,</l>
.<l n="b">paḍa ta sukhanikaṅ vvaṅ sakvehniṅ marək i sira,</l>
1070<l n="c">pramukha narapati mvaṅ śrī devyādisukhagiraṅ,</l>
.<l n="d">mihat iṅ anak apūrva lvir svapnopama kahiḍəp.</l>
. <!-- <app>7b H. suka magiraṅ sakveh.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
1075<lg n="8"><l n="a">ri tuhanira magə̄ṅ tan luptekan jaya riṅ ayun,</l>
.<l n="b">magadhapatī kalavān śryavaṅgādhipa matakut,</l>
.<l n="c">dadi ta mulih ikā saṅ kāśīndre surabhavana,</l>
.<l n="d">kumalilir ika maṅkin vṛddhyaṅ śaktyaparimita.</l>
. <!-- <app>8a C. D. E. F. H. luptekin.
1080 b: metrical problem?
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="9"><l n="a">tuvin atiśaya bhakti jə̄ṅ śrī hastinanagara,</l>
.<l n="b">dəlitikiṅ anak iṅ de rāma śrī nṛpatisuta,</l>
1085<l n="c">satata pinakamukhyāntyān iṅ pārthiva manuku,</l>
.<l n="d">məjahi sahananiṅ daityāmukvūk manəki vana.</l>
. <!-- <app>9c G. D. E. F. H. manukū.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
1090
.<lg n="10"><l n="a">nahan ikana vuvus saṅ paṇḍyārūm ri nṛpasuta,</l>
.<l n="b">tumalatah i kaśaktin kāśīndrātiśaya dahat,</l>
.<l n="c">muvah ika nṛpaputrāminte jə̄ṅ paramamuni,</l>
.<l n="d">majarakna ri* saṅkanyaṅ śatrv aṅrusuhi jagat.</l>
1095 <!-- <app> * D. E. F. G. — 10d A. B. C. H. majarakna saṅka.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="11"><l n="a">apan atiśaya śaktīṅ praṅ sakveh para nṛpati,</l>
.<l n="b">ndya kari maḍana vūk saṅ kāśīndra hari sakala,</l>
1100<l n="c">makin aṅibəki tekaṅ yakṣa lvīr alun aṅasut,</l>
.<l n="d">jumahatakən i sakvehniṅ rājyopama banava.</l>
. <!-- <app>11a E. F. sakveh saṅ para.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
1105
.</div>
.<div type="canto" rend="met" n="21" met="FILL-ME-IN">
.<lg n="1"><l n="a">nahan vuvus nṛpaputra riṅ kaki,</l>
.<l n="b">om liṅnira mpuṅku ri saṅ nṛpātmaja,</l>
1110<l n="c">sakveh maharṣīki susākṣi kottama,</l>
.<l n="d">yatnān ruməṅve savuvus ra saṅhulun.</l>
. <!-- <app>1b B. mpuṅku saṅ.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
1115<lg n="2"><l n="a">ṅūnin huvus saṅ prabhu pāṇḍaveśvara,</l>
.<l n="b">mantuk mareṅ svarga maluy nirātmaka,</l>
.<l n="c">sakvehniraṅ bhūpati devamūrtika,</l>
.<l n="d">miśreṅ tayārəs lakuniṅ kalin təka.</l>
.</lg>
1120<lg n="3"><l n="a">ndātan dva yekā* hana rākṣasādhipa,</l>
.<l n="b">dom vulvacarmā vəsi mūrtiniṅ kali,</l>
.<l n="c">riṅ gə̄ṅ ruhur** tulya sumeru bhāsvara,</l>
.<l n="d">krūrādbhutānāma si śūciloma ya.</l>
. <!-- <app> * C. D. E. H. ** D. — 3a A. B. F. tekā. — 3d A. B. G. E. F. G. H. luhur.
1125</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="4"><l n="a">mohāmunah siṅ sahaneṅ jagattraya,</l>
.<l n="b">devādi janmoraga sattva kāsihan,</l>
.<l n="c">naṣṭāpunah denya təkapnya gə̄ṅ galak,</l>
1130<l n="d">sākṣāt bhaṭāreśvara kālarūpaka.</l>
. <!-- <app>4c H. bhraṣṭāpunah.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="5"><l n="a">nā hetu saṅ śrī jinarājadevata,</l>
1135<l n="b">kapvātəmah rājasutāvəlas iṅ jagat,</l>
.<l n="c">khyātīṅ sarāt śryagrakumāra sajñika,</l>
.<l n="d">śīghrāṅlagekaṅ danujātibhīṣaṇa.</l>
. <!-- <app>6c F. śryāgrakusuma.
.</app> -->
1140</lg>
.<lg n="6"><l n="a">sor taṅ mahārākṣasa deniraṅ raṇa,</l>
.<l n="b">ginəlutnirekā sira tan sah iṅ ḍaḍa,</l>
.<l n="c">gambhīra makral sira tan vənaṅ sinah,</l>
.<l n="d">lvir parvatendra bvatirān paniṇḍihi.</l>
1145 <!-- <app>6b B. ginəlut. — 6c B. gambīra.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="7"><l n="a">glānaṅ mahārākṣasa tan vənaṅ miṅər,</l>
.<l n="b">de śrī narendrātmaja śakti digjaya,</l>
1150<l n="c">hetunya tībrālək aminta jīvana,</l>
.<l n="d">bhyaktyātiśāntārəs i jə̄ṅ mahājina.</l>
. <!-- <app>7a C. tar vənaṅ.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
1155<lg n="8"><l n="a">lāvan muvah śabdanikaṅ mahāsura,</l>
.<l n="b">bhoh ndyāku hetunta nimittaniṅ jaya,
.āpan rare tan masaniṅ mahottama,</l>
.<l n="c">śaktyādhika ndin hana deva sātmya ya.</l>
. <!-- <app>8c B. C. D. H. raray.
1160</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="9"><l n="a">nā liṅnya mānārjanamūrti digjaya,</l>
.<l n="b">krūrādbhuteṅ rāt karaṇaṅku śaktimān,</l>
.<l n="c">nyaṅ bhūr bhuvah svah kavənaṅ ya cūrṇitan,</l>
1165<l n="d">ndyānuṅ muvah yāmagutaṅkvi riṅ raṇa.</l>
. <!-- <app>9a H. mānārjjanamūrti garjjita. — 9b C. the second line becomes the third line. D. E. H. hyaṅ Bajratikṣṇāgra haneṅ daləm ṅati. — 9c C. D. E. H. the third line becomes the fourth line. — 9d G. D. E. H. do not have this line.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="10"><l n="a">ṅkā tekanaṅ yakṣa maminta sihnira,</l>
1170<l n="b">mahyun vruhe saṅ pinakeṣṭya pālaga,</l>
.<l n="c">tan dadya liṅ saṅ jinamūrti durlabha,</l>
.<l n="d">yan tona deniṅ hati mūrkha hiṅsaka.</l>
.</lg>
.<lg n="11"><l n="a">hetunya <app><lem>mary adhika</lem><rdg wit="#edss">māryyādhika</rdg></app> hiṅsakojjvala,</l>
1175<l n="b">maṅgəh ri somyānikanaṅ karākṣasan,</l>
.<l n="c">hyunhyun manah śrī jinamūrti taṅgapa,</l>
.<l n="d">śīghrān sirojar vara <app><lem>dharmadeśanā</lem><rdg wit="#edss">dhaṛṃmadeśanā</rdg></app> .</l>
. <!-- <app>nc C. D. G. H. taṅgama.
.</app> -->
1180</lg>
.
.</div>
.<div type="canto" rend="met" n="22" met="FILL-ME-IN">
.<lg n="1"><l n="a">samaṅkana təvəknikān matapa riṅ giri suməkuṅ i muṣṭiniṅ hiḍəp,</l>
1185<l n="b">nirāgraha ri śaktiniṅ trimala ṣaḍripu paḍəm ika denya riṅ manah,</l>
.<l n="c">gənəp dvidaśa pañcavarṣa ri lavasnikan umulahakən kaśāntikān,</l>
.<l n="d">pəjah ta ya muvah narendrasuta mantuk iṅ amara jinendra sātmaka.</l>
. <!-- <app>1a H. nya yan matapa.
.</app> -->
1190</lg>
.<lg n="2"><l n="a">ikaṅ asura* śūciloma matəmah sudaśasuta suḍaṇḍa nāma ya,</l>
.<l n="b">prabhūttama ri ratnakāṇḍa phalaniṅ tapa tinəmunika ndātan vuruṅ,</l>
.<l n="c">pənuh sahananiṅ pravīra bala pārthiva gaṇa paḍa śakti sādara,</l>
.<l n="d">suvarṇa rajatādiratna riṅ kaḍatvan ika** kadi janārdanālaya.</l>
1195 <!-- <app> * B. C. D. E. H. ** B. C. D. H. — 2a B. C. D. E. H. asura. — 2d A. E. F. G. ira.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="3"><l n="a">anindyaguṇa śakti riṅ brata suśīla satuvuh ika* rāja bhūpati,</l>
.<l n="b">sudhīra ri kalakvan iṅ japa samādhi taman alupa riṅ jinasmṛti,</l>
1200<l n="c">ya kāraṇa bhaṭāra rudra manurun manurun iri siraṅ nareśvara,</l>
.<l n="d"><app><lem>prahāsana</lem><rdg wit="#edss">prahāsaṇa</rdg></app> ri kīrti saṅ paramabuddha ri gatinika śāntikātmaka.</l>
. <!-- <app> * D. H. — 3a A. B. C. E. F. G. ira. — 3c E. manurun i sih ireṅ. H. tumurun manurun. — 3d H. prayasana.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
1205<lg n="4"><l n="a">sirāṅarani saṅ jayāntaka ri saṅ prabhu sinivi ri ratnakāṇḍaka,</l>
.<l n="b">vimāna pakavāhananya* ya pasuṅnira kadi sihireṅ dhaneśvara,</l>
.<l n="c">bhaṭāra tuvi tan hanāməjahaneriyan apituvi yan** nareśvara,</l>
.<l n="d">muvah liṅira rudramūrti sakaleṅ raṇa pamuput ikaṅ anugraha.</l>
. <!-- <app> * F.H. ** B. — 4b A. B. C. D. E. G. makavāhana. — 4c A. C. D. E. F. G. H. apituvi yā. — 4d D. anugraha.
1210</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="5"><l n="a">təlas pva phalaniṅ tapenulahakən mahəli manah i saṅ mahāsura,</l>
.<l n="b">hilaṅ sihira riṅ jagat mari vəlasnya riṅ anəmu viyoga kāsihan,</l>
.<l n="c">təhər madəg ikaṅ kasiṅhan atighora paṅasih i bhaṭāra śaṅkara,</l>
1215<l n="d">ya hetunikanaṅ jagat girigirin sahananika təkeṅ kadevatan.</l>
. <!-- <app>6c C. H. paṅasih ira.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="6"><l n="a">kunaṅ kəta ri ṅūni mūlanika yan prabhu nara makarūpa rākṣasa,</l>
1220<l n="b">haneka jurubhojakārya mabaṅun jaṅan aṅinakane nareśvara,</l>
.<l n="c">amogha ta hilaṅ lavəhlavəhikān hinahal iṅ asu sūkarottama,</l>
.<l n="d">mijil ta ya mamet pahəlyanāmukaṅ kunapa jana təlas <app><lem>miniśrakən</lem><rdg wit="#edss">miniśrākən</rdg></app> .</l>
. <!-- <app>6a H. təka. — 6d H. manut paṅənyanamu.
.</app> -->
1225</lg>
.<lg n="7"><l n="a">haturnya ri narendra tan dva təka maṅrahati pamatəkiṅ* karākṣasan,</l>
.<l n="b">usāna riṅ usāna tapvan amaṅan jaṅan atiśaya bhukti ṣaḍrasa,</l>
.<l n="c">nimittanika yan matakvan i lavəhlavəh ika riṅ akārya tan bəsur,</l>
.<l n="d">nyameki pəjahanya yan matura madva karaṇanika <app><lem>jāti</lem><rdg wit="#edss">jati</rdg></app> tan salah.</l>
1230 <!-- <app> *H. — 7a A. B. C. D. E. F. G. pamatəkaṅ.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="8"><l n="a">ya hetunika yan təhər mutus akon akəlakəlana māṅsa maṅkana,</l>
.<l n="b">muvah sinagaleki śakta tinutiṅ prakaśita puruṣāda sājñika,</l>
1235<l n="c">nimittanika yan kinon milaga de sahanahananikaṅ vvaṅ iṅ puri,</l>
.<l n="d">təlas karuhunāmbək iṅ bala samūha para ratu makon gumiṇḍala.</l>
. <!-- <app>8b B. puruyani sājñika. H. śakti. — 8c B. C. D. E. F. G. iṅ pura. H. nimittanira.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
1240<lg n="9"><l n="a">ya kāraṇanikān mareṅ vana ri lambuṅ iṅ acala sumeru parvata,</l>
.<l n="b">makin ta ya mabhairavān maṅan ikaṅ nara makaratuniṅ mahāsura,</l>
.<l n="c">arəs sahananiṅ vatək ratu kabeh sakaparək i pamiṅgir iṅ vana,</l>
.<l n="d">teñuh tvas ika yan rinampas inaməs təkap i balanikaṅ jayāntaka.</l>
. <!-- <app>9b D. E. H. mabhairavāmaṅan. — 9d B. rinampas.
1245</app> -->
.</lg>
.
.</div>
.<div type="canto" rend="met" n="23" met="FILL-ME-IN">
1250<lg n="1"><l n="a">para ratu saṅ haneṅ pura ri ratnakāṇḍa ṅūniveh tikaṅ balagaṇa,</l>
.<l n="b">girigirin epu tan vriṅ ulahārəs iṅ sudaśaputra śakti riṅ ayun,</l>
.<l n="c">tuhutuhu rudramūrti maśarīra riṅ raṇa pasuṅ bhaṭāra karaṇa,</l>
.<l n="d">karaṇanika praṇāmya ya makon umantuka ri saṅ mahāsurapati.</l>
. <!-- <app>1b B. nlah arəs i.
1255</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="2"><l n="a">kraman umulih ya śīghra təka riṅ svarājya sahavīrarākṣasabala,</l>
.<l n="b">makin atighora yan siniviniṅ mahāsura para prabhūttama marək,</l>
.<l n="c">kuməl akətər kavəs rasanikaṅ triloka təkap iṅ balāpratihata,</l>
1260<l n="d">titir anəḍək kadevatan amūk surāpsarabalānavan suravadhū.*</l>
. <!-- <app>* B. C. D. F. H. — 2c B. kavos. — 2d A. E. G. suravadu.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="3"><l n="a">ya taṅ umarānaput para sabhūmi bhārata musuh yayah nṛpasuta,</l>
1265<l n="b">ndi karika yan vənaṅ təlasa de vatək ratu makādi dhātratanaya,</l>
.<l n="c">pituvi bhaṭāra viṣṇu parananta tan vənaṅ ikaṅ durātmakaripu,</l>
.<l n="d">ri hananikaṅ narendra naramāṅsa pāvak i titahnikaṅ kaliyuga.</l>
. <!-- <app>3C C. D. F. viṣṇu śaraṇanta.
.</app> -->
1270</lg>
.<lg n="4"><l n="a">ṅhiṅ atiki saṅ nare rasuta rakva saṅ pinalar iṅ samantabhuvana,</l>
.<l n="b">maḍəmana duhkhaniṅ jagat aṅuṅsya dharma yaśa kīrti riṅ pabharatan,</l>
.<l n="c">apan iṅ usānajanma kitaṅ agrasesuka <app><lem>ṅaranta</lem><rdg wit="#edss">ṅarants</rdg></app> vīra suyaśa,</l>
.<l n="d">svabhava kitān pamatyan i kamūrkhaniṅ kalana śūciloma vəkasan.</l>
1275</lg>
.<lg n="5"><l n="a">ika si jayāntaka pva təmah iṅ mahāsura si śūciloma tumuvuh,</l>
.<l n="b">kita sutasoma rakva ya təmah bhaṭāra sugateki tan dva maṅiku,</l>
.<l n="c">kaliṅan ikā tayeka juga lena saṅka ri kitāmrihaṅ ripu kula,</l>
.<l n="d">təlas ulih iṅ samādhi japamantra saṅ parama paṇḍitārya sulabha.</l>
1280 <!-- <app>5a B. patəmah.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.
.</div>
1285<div type="canto" rend="met" n="24" met="FILL-ME-IN">
.<lg n="1"><l n="a">nā liṅ munivara sumahur narendrasuta <app><lem>vādhaka</lem><rdg wit="#edss">vāḍaka</rdg></app> riṅ ujar arūm,</l>
.<l n="b"><app><lem>ḍū</lem><rdg wit="#edss">dhū</rdg></app> maṅkana kaki ya nimittani ṅhulun umuṅsir iṅ alas aləyəp,</l>
.<l n="c">rəsniṅ kinirakira kinon gumantya sivin iṅ bhuvana sukhatara,</l>
.<l n="d">bhūpālaka giṇa ya təkap narendra muharātaṅis analahasa.</l>
1290 <!-- <app>1a B. ryyujar. — 1d B. H. muharān taṅis. C. maharān. H. sira ya təkap.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="2"><l n="a">vetniṅ kajugulan umatək kahīnaniṅ amūrti tan karaṇanikā,</l>
.<l n="b">dūrān vənaṅa śaraṇaniṅ jagat ṅuni-ṅunin vihikana* malaga,</l>
1295<l n="c">āpan saṅ inabhimata ratvanindya varaṇāṣṭaguṇanira hana,</l>
.<l n="d">siṅhākṛti tuhutuhu siṅhabhūpati jagatpati paṅaran ira.**</l>
. <!-- <app>* C. D. E. H. ** E. F. — 2b A. F. G. H. vihaṅana. B. vitikana. — 2c H. rakvānindya karanāṣṭaguṇa. — 2d A. B. C. D. G. H. ika.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
1300<lg n="3"><l n="a">ndātan hananika viparīta yan vənaṅa bhūpati jaya vijaya,</l>
.<l n="b">ṅhiṅ rakva vanagamana muṇḍyaṅ enaka ri saṅ putu paramamuni,</l>
.<l n="c">denyan mamuṅarana gəgər manambuṅana liṅgihira saṅ atapa,</l>
.<l n="d">mvaṅ deniṅ apəniṅan iṅ adri rakva makire patapana karəsəp.</l>
. <!-- <app>3c B. D. nyān. — 3d H. don iṅ apəniṅan.
1305</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="4"><l n="a">nahan vacananira ri saṅ munīndra jəṅər epu maṅətəki hati,</l>
.<l n="b">oṁ saṅ nṛpasuta bapa hayva maṅkana jagat kasihana rumuhun,
.āpan niyata hilaṅ ikaṅ triloka təkap iṅ sudaśasutaripu,</l>
1310<l n="c">yan tan kita məjahana ratvaniṅ bhuvanaṅ uṅsirən iṅ aśaraṇa.</l>
. <!-- <app>4a H. epu aloṅ. — 4d B. aśāraṇa.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="5"><l n="a">sampun pva kakavaśa təkapta bhūpati jagat parahita suyaśa,</l>
1315<l n="b">yekān musira kita riṅ adri śūnya larisāmanaruka patapan,</l>
.<l n="c">bhāgyān mapagəha makapājaran ləyəpikaṅ svanagara lalunən,
.āpan sama karaṇaniṅ adbhutānəmu viśeṣa gatini kavuvus.</l>
. <!-- <app>6a H. subhaga.
.</app> -->
1320</lg>
.<lg n="6"><l n="a">śrī dharmasuta sira ri ṅūni pāṇḍutanayāgraja saphala tirun,</l>
.<l n="b">sākṣāt tuhatuha nṛpaputra bhāratakulāṅgəh ira ta suyaśa,</l>
.<l n="c">saṅkan raray atiki sirān jagatpati munīndra matəṅət iṅ ulah,</l>
.<l n="d">siddhārtha manəmu paramārthikeṅ nagara pajaran ira karəṅə̄.</l>
1325 <!-- <app>6b B. suyaśa.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="7"><l n="a">ndātan kənanika kita ratva māsku kaharəpkv iki tulusakna,</l>
.<l n="b">riṅ sāmaja maḍaḍa haləpnya rakva ranu padma mamahi kalaṅə̄n,</l>
1330<l n="c">rakryan buṅah i kəñar iṅ indu śīla paramāṅajəṅ iṅ anakbi,</l>
.<l n="d">aśvābharaṇanika ya śīghra riṅ gṛha sadotsava maṅulapakən.</l>
. <!-- <app>7b H. madəg ahaləp. — 7d B. riṅ gṛha siddhārda.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
1335<lg n="8"><l n="a">vetnyā karaṇa maṅajəṅ iṅ nadī mithuna haṅsan amuvuhi laṅə̄,</l>
.<l n="b">paṇḍyādhika makahaləp iṅ sabhā kula suputra maṅinaki riya,</l>
.<l n="c">lokatraya ravi pakabhūṣaṇanya suməṅ iṅ laṅit aṅaḍahaḍa,</l>
.<l n="d">rājyottama maṅaləpi bhūmimaṇḍala təkeṅ balagaṇa mabiṅar.</l>
. <!-- <app>8c B. C. makabhūsaṇa nya suməṅ iṅ laṅit aṅada-hada. — 8d B. C. rajottama.
1340</app> -->
.</lg>
.
.</div>
.<div type="canto" rend="met" n="25" met="FILL-ME-IN">
1345<lg n="1"><l n="a">ndan sira saṅ kṣinatriya tatan hana kahaləpirān jugenaka,</l>
.<l n="b">bheda sakeṅ nṛpaty ahulunaṅ bhuvana sivinən iṅ* jagat kabeh,</l>
.<l n="c">loka parāśrayeṅ guṇa sudhīra nipuṇa ri karakṣan iṅ jagat,</l>
.<l n="d">dharma viśeṣa tan panasareṅ aji salaku nirātidigjaya.</l>
. <!-- <app> * B. D. H. — 1b A. G. E. F. G. sinivi niṅ. — 1c B. G. E. karākṣan iṅ prajā.
1350</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="2"><l n="a">pāpa kapāpa tan dva tumuvuh pva liṅanira putuṅku riṅ prabhu,</l>
.<l n="b">dūran ikaṅ kaśāntikan i deniran aməjahi vighnaniṅ jagat,</l>
.<l n="c">siṅgih ujarta yogya ta lamun balapati caraṇanta digjaya,</l>
1355<l n="d">ṅhiṅ juga hayva lakṣaṇa kitāmagəhakna tikaṅ jinasmṛti.</l>
.</lg>
.<lg n="3"><l n="a">maṅkana denirāvacana dharma pitutur i siraṅ nṛpātmaja,</l>
.<l n="b">mvaṅ sira saṅ vatək ṛṣi kabeh prasama sira maṅastvakən vuvus,</l>
.<l n="c">saṅ nṛpaputra tan vavarəṅə̄ sira ri pamidi saṅ mahayati,</l>
1360<l n="d">ṅhiṅ parameṣṭhibuddha kinənəpnira tulusa Mahāyānabrata.</l>
.</lg>
.
.</div>
.<div type="canto" rend="met" n="26" met="FILL-ME-IN">
1365<lg n="1"><l n="a">səḍəṅ kepvan saṅ paṇḍita sira təkap saṅ nṛpasuta,</l>
.<l n="b">bəlah taṅ bhūmi ṅke harəpira maṅaṅ teja dumilah,</l>
.<l n="c">bhaṭārī saṅ hyaṅniṅ kṣiti sira mijil bhāsvara katon,</l>
.<l n="d">caturhastānindyābharaṇamukha sākṣāt śaśadhara.</l>
. <!-- <app>1d H. mamuka lvir daśaśara.
1370</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="2"><l n="a">rikān prāptānəmbah sira məkul i jə̄ṅ bhāratakula,</l>
.<l n="b">gəyuh tan śobhāṅluh malara ruməṅə̄ reh nṛpasuta,</l>
.<l n="c">ahā saṅ śrī śāstrātmaka lihat i bhaktiṅkv iri kita,</l>
1375<l n="d">praṇāmyātaṅgəh donta yadi jənəkeṅ kanana sabhā.</l>
. <!-- <app>2b H. śobhālā maya lara niba de nṛpasuta.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="3"><l n="a">ri tan somyanteṅ bhūmi sahana muvah riṅ kadi kami,</l>
1380<l n="b">avās taṅ rāt syuh durbala ri pamatəkniṅ kaliyuga,</l>
.<l n="c">mahī nirvījekaṅ <app><lem>rasa nirasa</lem><rdg wit="#edss">raṣa niraṣa</rdg><note>Should one understand rasa nīrasa?</note></app> taṅ nīca sulabha,</l>
.<l n="d">narendrāthelik* riṅ parahita mahādharma viśata.</l>
. <!-- <app> * B. C. D. E. — 3d A. F. G. H. narendrātelik.
.</app> -->
1385</lg>
.<lg n="4"><l n="a">tumūt sakveh saṅ paṇḍita paramaviprādikaluṣa,</l>
.<l n="b">ndātan maṅgəh vidyākramanira tuna jñāna vimala,</l>
.<l n="c">viśīrṇaṅ strī drohī priya suta pitā dveṣa lumari,</l>
.<l n="d">hanekaṅ dharma sthāna kuṭi kavanan tan hana mulat.*</l>
1390 <!-- <app>* B. C. D. E. F. G. H. — 4c B. suta pīta. A. mulata.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="5"><l n="a">daridrākveh dātāsugih akuməd atyanta kasihan,</l>
.<l n="b">dhirāyuh <app><lem>taṅ</lem><rdg wit="#edss">tan</rdg></app> pāpī tuna hurip ikaṅ buddhi kuśala,</l>
1395<l n="c">kulīnādāśālpaṅ kujana ratu siṅ māna sinivi,</l>
.<l n="d">pratiṅkahniṅ rāt yan kaliyuga sukhāmbək diyadiyu.</l>
. <!-- <app>5b B. tapa pītuna. G. sirāyuh taṅ papituna. D. F. taṅ papituna. E. dhīrāyuh tāpā pituna. — 5c A. E. kujana ratu.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
1400<lg n="6"><l n="a">ya tāṅde kleśaṅkun rasa bubulan aṅgaṅ kṣititala,</l>
.<l n="b">təkapniṅ mūrkhātyanta kujana mahānāraka rasa,</l>
.<l n="c">kasəṅkvan deniṅ rākṣasa sudaśaputraprabhu ta ya,</l>
.<l n="d">alah bvatniṅ saptāṇḍa girigaṇa denyādbhuta təmən.</l>
. <!-- <app>6a C. yaya tāṅde. — 6c C. prabhutala.
1405</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="7"><l n="a">tuvin meh prāptāṅekajaladhi* təmahniṅ tribhuvana,</l>
.<l n="b">vināśaṅ rāt noraṅ daśadiśi mamə̄ṅ tan patuduhan,</l>
.<l n="c">bhaṭāra hyaṅ śrī buddha śiva vinayācintya kahiḍəp,</l>
1410<l n="d">təkapniṅ gālaknyādbhuta danuja nā maṅdadi ta ya.</l>
. <!-- <app> * B. C. E. F. G. H. — 7a A. prāptāṅde kajaladhi təmah niṅ. — 7d B. gālāk.
. -jaladhi &lt; -jaladdhi
.</app> -->
.</lg>
1415
.</div>
.<div type="canto" rend="met" n="27" met="FILL-ME-IN">
.<lg n="1"><l n="a">maṅkā ta təmahan ikanaṅ jagat yadi kitān maləməha sivinən,
.āpan taya huməjahane kaśaktin ikanaṅ sudaśasutaripu,</l>
1420<l n="b">yāvat kaliyuga jinamūrti saṅ prabhu vənaṅ tribhuvanaśaraṇa,</l>
.<l n="c">tāvat salah ika niyataṅ sarāt manemu duhkha haruhara sadā.</l>
. <!-- <app>1a B. G. H. ndah maṅkana. C. E. ndah samaṅkana təmah ikanaṅ. D. ndah maṅkana təma tikana.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
1425<lg n="2"><l n="a">liṅ śrī kṣititala ri* huvusnirān praṇata mūkṣa mamarəṅi kəḍap,</l>
.<l n="b">svapnopama ri hiḍəpiraṅ munīndra sama harṣaja mihat i sira,</l>
.<l n="c">kapvānut i savuvusiraṅ mahīdhara ləves hayunira pituhun,**
.sākṣāt vvayulih*** iṅ amutər tasik təkapirāmṛta ri yativara.</l>
. <!-- <app> * B. C. D. E. F. H. ** C. D. E. H. *** B. G. D. E. F. G. H. — 2a A. G. Kṣititala huvusnirān. — 2c A. B. F. G. pitutur. — 2d A. vah ulih.
1430</app> -->
.</lg>
.
.</div>
.<div type="canto" rend="met" n="28" met="FILL-ME-IN">
1435<lg n="1"><l n="a">ndan śrī bhūpatiputra tan vavarəṅə̄ tiṅkah bhaṭārī kṣiti,</l>
.<l n="b">māyābañcana rakva liṅnira təkapniṅ buddhi nissaṅśaya,</l>
.<l n="c">yekāṅde lara saṅ maputra karuhun sakvehni saṅ paṇḍita,</l>
.<l n="d">saṅkeṅ vəlasnira riṅ triloka muharaṅ luh maryavān* riṅ vijaṅ.</l>
. <!-- <app> * B. D. — 1c B. G. D. E. F. H. niraṅ paṇḍita. — 1d A. F. G. H. mār pavān. C. mārpatan. E. mār ppavān.
1440</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="2"><l n="a">vvantən teki muvah maharṣi mavuvus sodāhaṅan riṅ manah,</l>
.<l n="b">he śrī bhūpatiputra hayva kəta maṅkāmbəkta <app><lem>mūḍheṅ</lem><rdg wit="#edss">muḍeṅ</rdg></app> jagat,</l>
.<l n="c">nicchā śāsana saṅ narārya yadiyan luṅhāmriheṅ śūnyata,</l>
1445<l n="d">tīrthāmet <app><lem>viṣa</lem><rdg wit="#edss">vīṣa</rdg></app> sadṛśanta* viphalaṅ svargā madadyaṅ kavah.</l>
. <!-- <app> *B. D. E. — 2d A. C. F. G. H. sadṛsanta.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="3"><l n="a">āpan rakva tuvuhta yekan inusir saṅ vṛddhavṛddheṅ tapa,</l>
1450<l n="b">riṅ rūpādhika vāni śaktiguṇamān janmottamānindita,</l>
.<l n="c">maṅgəh rakva tumirv i rūmta saphalāntukniṅ kayogīśvaran,</l>
.<l n="d">toh ndyānuṅ palarənta pan kita təmahniṅ yoga sānusmṛti.</l>
. <!-- <app>3c C. E. H. tumirva.
.</app> -->
1455</lg>
.<lg n="4"><l n="a">saṅsiptanya tuhanku nora phalaniṅ gə̄ṅ sūkṣma muṅgv iṅ vana,</l>
.<l n="b">de saṅ kṣatriyajanma vīra taruṇātaṅgvan viśeṣeṅ* jagat,</l>
.<l n="c">vvaṅ mūḍhādhama kevalaṅhat iṅ ujar nistṛṣṇa dhīreṅ brata,</l>
.<l n="d">byaktāvās kabaliknya yan lamulamun śīghra təkaṅ pātaka.</l>
1460 <!-- <app> * B. C. E. H. — 4b A. D. F. G. viśeṣaṅ. — 4c B. G. E. G. H. kevalāhat. — 4d D. E. H. śīghrān.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="5"><l n="a">nāhan teki vuvusnirāsəmu pacəh sakvehni rovaṅnira,</l>
.<l n="b">mitra ṅganya təkapnirekana mahāprānarṣi rakvāvuvus,</l>
1465<l n="c">hāh dūrān hana mātraniṅhulun ike mvaṅ saṅ munīndrādhipa,</l>
.<l n="d"><app><lem>śraddhānūta</lem><rdg>śṛddhānūta</rdg></app> rikaṅ prayojana hade tan dharma saṅ paṇḍita.</l>
. <!-- <app>5a D. teka vuvus. — 5b B. H. mahāviprārthi rakvaṅ. C. mahāviprāṛṣi.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
1470<lg n="6"><l n="a">siṅgih yan sira sasar kapətəṅan deniṅ manah saṅśaya,</l>
.<l n="b">lagyāgəgvan ikaṅ sukhābhyudaya kāṣṭeśvarya lābhātupis,</l>
.<l n="c">yan miśrā kalavan bhaṭāra kəta yan śakrādi tapvan harəp,</l>
.<l n="d">ṅhiṅ saṅ hyaṅ paramārtha buddha kinənəp saṅ siddha yogīśvara.</l>
. <!-- <app>6a B. D. G. H. sira saṅ kapətəṅan. — 6c C. lavan bhaṭāra. D. E. F. G. H. yadyan miśrā lavan.
1475</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="7"><l n="a">liṅtekin viphalaṅ tapenulahakən de saṅ mahākṣatriya,</l>
.<l n="b">mon hyaṅ mon vara kinnarendra suranāthādinya tan vādakan,</l>
.<l n="c">tonən hyaṅ parameṣṭhi rudra matapeṅ mervādiparvatālama,</l>
1480<l n="d">hyaṅniṅ hyaṅ suraniṅ sureka matapā* ndyānuṅ pinet denira,</l>
. <!-- <app>* B. D. E. F. H. — 7b B. tan vvadakan. — 7d A. C. G. matapa.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.
1485</div>
.<div type="canto" rend="met" n="29" met="FILL-ME-IN">
.<lg n="1"><l n="a">kalīṅan ika tan haneki halaniṅ tumutakən i manah munīśvara,</l>
.<l n="b">kalīṅan ika saṅ narendrasuta mānuṣa sinaput i śaktiniṅ tamah,</l>
.<l n="c">bhaṭāra tuvi nora lena saka riṅ tapa vinaṅun ireṅ trikāyika,</l>
1490<l n="d">haneka malihaṅ pinetnira turuṅ katəmu tinəmuniṅ tutur hiḍəp.</l>
. <!-- <app>1d H. mali saṅ pinet nira turuṅ katəmu ri pagəh iṅ tutur hiḍəp.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="2"><l n="a">avās kita rike* manah saṅ anəmu krama tinəmuni saṅ huvus licin,</l>
1495<l n="b">sirānəmunəmu ndatan paṅaku yan katəmu rusit i sandhiniṅ hiḍəp,</l>
.<l n="c">taṅeh yan ucapən kavāstvanira** riṅ tribhuvana riṅ apan kapaṅgiha,</l>
.<l n="d">prasiddhaṅ atiśūnya mārga kinənəp nṛpasuta tinut iṅ manah ləṅə̄ṅ.</l>
. <!-- <app> * B. G. D. E. F. G. ** B. C. D. E. H. — 2a A. rika. H. avās nika kite. — 2c. A. F. G. havāstvan. — 2d D. mārgga.
.</app> -->
1500</lg>
.<lg n="3"><l n="a">kitāvacana* buddhi mūḍha ri sirān balik ika kita mūḍha kaśmala,**
.pitovi sira buddhamūrti riṅ apan sira kavatəka riṅ punarbhava,</l>
.<l n="b">hana pva gatiniṅ hulun sama mamākṣa*** sira sivinən iṅ jagat kabeh,</l>
.<l n="c">takutkv i ruganiṅ triloka ri huvusnira maluyeṅ tapovana.</l>
1505 <!-- <app> * B. C. D. E. F. ** E. *** C. — 3a A. G. H. kitāvacana. A. B. C. D. F. G. H. kāsmala. — 3c A. B. D. E. F. G. H. mapākṣa.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="4"><l n="a">nahan liṅira dharmamūrti tətəs iṅ kahuvusan i sinādhya saṅ viku,</l>
.<l n="b">muvah sahana saṅ munīndra sama māstvakən i vuvusirātipaṇḍita,</l>
1510<l n="c">kunaṅ rasika saṅ śinabdan apa tan sahur asəmu viraṅ muṅismuṅis,</l>
.<l n="d">nimittanira yan milag kadi rare cala katəṅər i duhkhaniṅ manah.</l>
.</lg>
.<lg n="5"><l n="a">samantara ḍatəṅ tikaṅ surasa bhojana haraka bhinukti tan kuraṅ,</l>
.<l n="b">kilaṅ brəm ika śukla rakva panəgəh munivara ri siraṅ nṛpātmaja,</l>
1515<l n="c">byatīta* ri huvusnirānaḍah anindya sukha sira təkap munīśvara,</l>
.<l n="d">narendrasuta kapva mamvit i munīndra kahənəṅan i denirān laku.</l>
. <!-- <app> * B. C. D. G. H. — 5b C. panaṅgəh. — 5c A. E. F. byaktīta.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
1520<lg n="6"><l n="a">nda śīghra ri ləpasnirān pramukha keśava dumulur i saṅ nṛpātmaja,</l>
.<l n="b">taluntalun i pārśvaniṅ vukir aneka kayu rəbah i piṅgiriṅ havan,</l>
.<l n="c">pətuṅpətuṅ i salvaṅ iṅ gəgər avor i vuluh ika rumambayiṅ paruṅ,</l>
.<l n="d">guhāpəṅuṅ ika daləmnya pilih uṅgvan i macan ika ghora gə̄ṅ galak.</l>
. <!-- <app>6c F. səlvaṅ.
1525</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="7"><l n="a">kidulnnya hana tīrtha nirmala sake ruhur i pucak ikaṅ gunuṅ magə̄ṅ,</l>
.<l n="b">təḍunya gumuruh təkeṅ juraṅ avarṇa gərəh i pasurakniṅ ampuhan,</l>
.<l n="c">i sornya dəṅən arja saṅgar avavar janur akiṅ asamīpa kahyaṅan,</l>
1530<l n="d">pilih makapamūrchitan təkap i saṅ kavi hana səsəran tanah tikəl.</l>
. <!-- <app>7c H. kahaṅan.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="8"><l n="a">narendrasuta yeka tan dva marahup sira vəkasan asūryasevana,*
1535təlas kahalivat** larisnira sakerika saha <app><lem>ṛṣisaṅgha</lem><rdg wit="#edss">ṛṣisaṅghya</rdg></app> maṅdulur,</l>
.<l n="b">juraṅjuraṅ arəs haneki vaṭavṛkṣa kəpuh agəṅ arambayan matə̄b,</l>
.<l n="c">paranti paran iṅ mahakalana duṣṭa mamatimati sattva riṅ vana.</l>
. <!-- <app> * B. C. E. H. ** B. C. — 8a A. D. F. G. asūryyaśevana. — 8b A. D. E. F. G. H. ta halivat. B. madulur.
.</app> -->
1540</lg>
.<lg n="9"><l n="a">rikā pravara keśavājar i narendrasuta ri hananiṅ mahāsura,</l>
.<l n="b">gajendramukha śūcilomasuta tattvanika paṅavak iṅ kalīn* təkā,</l>
.<l n="c">avaknya kadi parvatāgəṅ aruhur** matanika ravitulya yāpaḍaṅ,</l>
.<l n="d">galaknya kadi kālarudra mihat iṅ bhuvana ri səḍəṅ iṅ prakampita.</l>
1545 <!-- <app> * B. ** B. C. D. E. F. H. — 9b A. G. D. E. F. G. H. Kalin. — 9c A. G. aluhur. H. ravitulya bhāsvara.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="10"><l n="a">nimittanika yañcaturbhuja baṅun paśupatisuta riṅ praṅ adbhuta,</l>
.<l n="b">gaṇañjaya sirāṅanugrahani ṅūni ri patapan ikaṅ himālaya,</l>
1550<l n="c">tinūtnya maṅaran si durmukha təkapnira karaṇanikojjvaleṅ raṇa,</l>
.<l n="d">bhaṭāra tuvi tan vənaṅ məjahaneriya pamuput ikaṅ hanugraha.</l>
. <!-- <app>10c H. niṅ kojvaleṅ.
. nimittanika yañcaturbhuja: or read nimittani kāyāñcaturbhuja? nimittanika yāñcaturbhuja?
.</app> -->
1555</lg>
.
.<lg n="11"><l n="a">ya hetunika yan vənaṅ mamati sesiniṅ acala mṛgādibhakṣaṇa,</l>
.<l n="b">təkeṅ jaladhi mīna durbala təlas pəsut ika rinaməs lavan mumul,</l>
.<l n="c">muvah sahana saṅ tapasvi karikā saka sasiki cinidra riṅ vəṅi,</l>
1560<l n="d">arəs girigirin sahimbaṅ ikanaṅ giri təkapni ṅarenikaṅ vukir.</l>
. <!-- <app>11b B. durbbala. — 11c B. karikān. E. tapasvi tan saka. H. karikan.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="12"><l n="a">kalīṅan ika hayva māskun amənər manalajuṅ irikaṅ kəpuh magə̄ṅ,</l>
1565<l n="b">mahābhaya təmən yadin kita kaciryana təkap ikanaṅ mahāsura,</l>
.<l n="c">nihan tutən ikaṅ havan manəṅən iṅ gəgər i ləpit ikaṅ gunuṅ kidul,</l>
.<l n="d">rikan tuməḍuneṅ* juraṅ pravala tan kahavarana sinādhyaniṅ manah.</l>
. <!-- <app> * C. D. H. — 12d A. B. E. F. G. tuməḍun iṅ.
.</app> -->
1570</lg>
.<lg n="13"><l n="a">siraṅ nṛpatiputra mogha vihaṅākral i pasayutirārya paṇḍita,</l>
.<l n="b">kasattvikanireṅ jagat tumuvuhārdha təka mavəlas iṅ kamāṅsaka,</l>
.<l n="c">nimittanira yan harəp vruha rikaṅ gajamukhamaya* vighnaniṅ jagat,</l>
.<l n="d">malar sira vənaṅ tumaṅgəhana tan dahatanika** makārya duryaśa.</l>
1575 <!-- <app> * C. D. E. F. G. H. ** B. C. E. F. G. H. — 13b G. kamaṅsakā. — 13c A. B. gajamuka vighna. — 13d A. D. dahat.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.
.</div>
1580<div type="canto" rend="met" n="30" met="FILL-ME-IN">
.<lg n="1"><l n="a">ya hetu saṅ śrī naranāthaputra,</l>
.<l n="b">parah tikaṅ vṛkṣa lavan maharṣi,</l>
.<l n="c">katon tikaṅ bāluṅ amarvatāgə̄ṅ,</l>
.<l n="d">kapāla* śelanya paraṅnya danta.</l>
1585 <!-- <app> * C. D. — 1b C. parah ikaṅ. D. parar tikaṅ. — 1d A. B. E. F. G. H. kaphāla.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="2"><l n="a">dukāla lātānya ḍukutnya roma,</l>
.<l n="b">vədiṅvədiṅ vastra rujit sukətnya,</l>
1590<l n="c">haturnikaṅ sattva jana prakīrṇa,</l>
.<l n="d">pəjah təkapniṅ gajavaktra mūrkha.</l>
. <!-- <app>2c C. hatur.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
1595<lg n="3"><l n="a">byatīta lampahnira śīghrāgāmi,</l>
.<l n="b">təkerikan gadgada durmukhāhya,</l>
.<l n="c">mələd maṅilvākrak asindhughoṣa,</l>
.<l n="d">prakopa yar ton naranāthaputra.</l>
. <!-- <app>3c H. asindughora.
1600</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="4"><l n="a">aho syape koṅ nara dibyarūpa,</l>
.<l n="b">təkery aku mvaṅ ṛṣi śuddhavarṇa,</l>
.<l n="c">ləvəs ri tan vruhmu rikaṅ parāna,</l>
1605<l n="d">lugeṅ urip parvata <app><lem>laṅghana</lem><rdg wit="#edss">laṅghyana</rdg></app> ṅke.</l>
.</lg>
.<lg n="5"><l n="a">ndya teku kāryanyu dumeh para ṅke,</l>
.<l n="b">mṛgendra khāgādhipa deva tovi,</l>
.<l n="c">tamantameṅ* adri sukhasvabhāva,</l>
1610<l n="d">təkapku jīva kṣaya riṅ vanādri.</l>
. <!-- <app> * B. C. D. E. — 5c A. F. G. H. tapeṅ.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="6"><l n="a">lavan syapeki pva ṅaranmu riṅ rāt,</l>
1615<l n="b">pilih mahākinnara devarāja,</l>
.<l n="c">sake haləptādhika dibyarūpa,</l>
.<l n="d">smarāmarānuṅ pinakopamanta.</l>
. <!-- <app>6c B. D. divyarūpa.
.</app> -->
1620</lg>
.<lg n="7"><l n="a">bhaṭāra viṣṇu pva kunaṅ liṅanku,</l>
.<l n="b">kiteky amūrti hyaṅ anaṅga duṣṭa,</l>
.<l n="c">prayojanāṅadva gəṅiṅ kaśaktin,</l>
.<l n="d">ulah pva dehādbhuta cakrapāṇi.</l>
1625 <!-- <app>7a D. liṅaṅku. — 7d B. nda lah pva.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="8"><l n="a">trivikramānuṅ makapāṅadanta,</l>
.<l n="b">taṅan catur mevvivu saṅkhya ghora,</l>
1630<l n="c">śirah susun sapta matumpatumpaṅ,</l>
.<l n="d">aneka sevu lvirikaṅ matakveh.</l>
. <!-- <app>8a D. makapaṅadānta. — 8c E. F. matumpa-tumpa.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
1635<lg n="9"><l n="a">ikā ta rūpanta lavan guṇanta,</l>
.<l n="b">tahā* ṅhulun sora təkapmu riṅ praṅ,</l>
.<l n="c">yadin kamu hyaṅ suranātha maṅko,</l>
.<l n="d">hilaṅ tikaṅ bajra vibajra de ṅku.</l>
. <!-- <app> * C. F. — 9b A. B. D. E. G. H. taha. H. təkapta.
1640</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="10"><l n="a">nahan vuvusniṅ gajavaktra rodra,</l>
.<l n="b">narendraputrādbhuta sārjavājar,</l>
.<l n="c">tatan surendrāku tatan hari hyaṅ,</l>
1645<l n="d">mahājana kṣatriya bhāratāṅśa.</l>
.</lg>
.<lg n="11"><l n="a">ṅhulun suta śrī nṛpa hastinendra,</l>
.<l n="b">prakāśa sajñā sutasoma riṅ rāt,</l>
.<l n="c">mareṅ girīśṛṅga sinādhya tan len,</l>
1650<l n="d">girīndrarājeki ginə̄ṅkv iṅ ambək.</l>
.</lg>
.<lg n="12"><l n="a">kunəṅ nimittaṅku təkeṅ kita ṅke,</l>
.<l n="b">ndatan takut matya* kabhuktya denta,**
.mahāyaśārtheki sudharma pinrih,</l>
1655<l n="c">sudharma dharmohuta riṅ mahiṅsa.</l>
. <!-- <app> * D. ** B. C. D. E. F. G. H. — 12b A. B. C. E. F. G. H. matya. A. demu. — 12c H. mahāyaśanteki.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="13"><l n="a">apan mahāpātakaṅ arddha hiṅsa,</l>
1660<l n="b">tiniṇḍa riṅ rāt para sādhu melik,</l>
.<l n="c">madoh sakeṅ śūnyapadān paratra,*
.sasar mareṅ <app><lem>gomukhatāmra</lem><rdg wit="#edss">gohmukatamra</rdg></app> ** təmbe.</l>
. <!-- <app> * B. ** B. C. D. E. F. H. — 13b C. D. E. niṅ. — 13c A. G. D. E. F. G. H. paratra. — 13d A. G. gohmukatambra.
.</app> -->
1665</lg>
.<lg n="14"><l n="a">sahasravarṣa pva kitān hana ṅkā,</l>
.<l n="b">tinūt təkapniṅ yamabhṛtyayodha,</l>
.<l n="c">ndātan mati tan mahurip gatinya,</l>
.<l n="d">saranta gə̄ṅ duhkha sadālare tvas.</l>
1670 <!-- <app>14b B. dinuk.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="15"><l n="a">ya teka pamratniṅ akārya hiṅsa,</l>
.<l n="b">rajah tamah tan surud iṅ svacitta,</l>
1675<l n="c">hilaṅ tikaṅ sattva təkapnikāṅdoh,</l>
.<l n="d">hilaṅnikā śīghra təkeṅ aveci.</l>
. <!-- <app>15c C. hikaṅ satva. — 18d D. nikān śīghra.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
1680<lg n="16"><l n="a">tumūt mareṅ* ṣaḍripu śatru riṅ jro,</l>
.<l n="b">trivighna pañcendriya mogha darpa,</l>
.<l n="c">sudhīra māmah vukir iṅ śarīra,</l>
.<l n="d">ri tan hanāniṅ mahasattva bhasma.</l>
. <!-- <app> * E. — 16a A. B. C. D. F. G. H. maraṅ. — 18d E. bhasmā.
1685</app> -->
.</lg>
.
.</div>
.<div type="canto" rend="met" n="31" met="FILL-ME-IN">
1690<lg n="1"><l n="a">ndah yeka rakva magave laraniṅ triloka,</l>
.<l n="b">siddhātəmah tanu gajendramukhādipāpa,</l>
.<l n="c">bhinneka* rakva kalavan gaṇarājadeva,</l>
.<l n="d">icchā svabhāvanira yan gajavaktrarūpa.</l>
. <!-- <app>* B. — 1c A. C. D. E. F. G. H. bhineka</app> -->
1695</lg>
.<lg n="2"><l n="a">lāvan jagatśaraṇa hetuniṅ āsyacūrṇa,</l>
.<l n="b">daityādirāja pəjaheki təkap bhaṭāra,</l>
.<l n="c">sūkṣmātisūkṣmamaya śakti mahāprabhāva,</l>
.<l n="d">sotniṅ viśeṣa vinuvus smaradagdaputra *</l>
1700 <!-- <app>* B. C. D. E. F. G. — 2a B. asyacūrṇṇa. — 2d A. vinuvus maradagdaputra. H. pinupus Smaradagdaputra.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="3"><l n="a">tan maṅka teka kita kevala durmukhāhya,</l>
.<l n="b">tapvan maveh sukhanikaṅ bhuvanāprameya,</l>
1705<l n="c">lobhavərə̄ kavigaran kadi hastisattva,</l>
.<l n="d">dūrān vənaṅ śaraṇaniṅ bhuvanāṇḍarāja.</l>
.</lg>
.<lg n="4"><l n="a">vvantən pva hetuniṅ anindya caturbhujeṅ praṅ,</l>
.<l n="b">tan sih bhaṭāra juga kevala pātakāgə̄ṅ,</l>
1710<l n="c">hāh yogya tiṅgalaknaṅ gajavaktrarūpa,</l>
.<l n="d">rūpanta teka tinut iṅ pati tan tinaṅgəl.</l>
. <!-- <app>4c H. yogya nya. — 4d H. yeka tinut.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
1715<lg n="5"><l n="a">hetunya maṅkana haneki viśeṣa nātha,</l>
.<l n="b">brahmāja rakva panəlahnira dhātraputra,</l>
.<l n="c">rākaṅku parṇahira teki jagatpraṇamya,</l>
.<l n="d">ghorānivārya daśabāhu səḍəṅnikaṅ praṅ.</l>
. <!-- <app>6C H. yeka jagat pramaṇa.
1720</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="6"><l n="a">bhraṣṭaṅ vatək kalaṇa denira riṅ raṇāṅga,</l>
.<l n="b">daityādi rākṣasa pəjah sahananya bhasma,</l>
.<l n="c">yekān takutkv i kita yan vruha saṅ narendra,</l>
1725<l n="d">byaktān ri duhkhanira pan kita buddhimūrkha.</l>
.</lg>
.<lg n="7"><l n="a">ndah kantənanya paṅucapkv i gajendravaktra,</l>
.<l n="b">sattvādicitta rəgəpən pva mahāviśeṣa,</l>
.<l n="c">krodhanta patyana tamahta ya dohakənta,</l>
1730<l n="d">kāruṇyabuddhi gavayən tulakanta mṛtyu.</l>
.</lg>
.<lg n="8"><l n="a">yapvan vihaṅeku* virodha manahta maṅke,</l>
.<l n="b">hiṅsākuru pravala deni kaduryaśanta,</l>
.<l n="c">byaktaṅ svajīva matupis guṇa śaktimaṇḍa,</l>
1735<l n="d">de śrī narendra sakaleśvara bhūmipāla.</l>
. <!-- <app> * D. G. — 8a B. C. yapvan virodha vilaṅeku, D. E. G. yapvan virodha vihaṅeku. H. yapvan virodha vahaneki. — 8b B. kaduryyaśanta.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.
1740<lg n="9"><l n="a">nāhan vuvus nṛpasutāmuji saṅ narārya,</l>
.<l n="b">marmānumodana ri saṅ gajavaktrarūpa,</l>
.<l n="c">durvaktra heva ya təkap naranāthaputra,</l>
.<l n="d">iṣṭanya cañcala baṅun gajavaktra rudra.</l>
. <!-- <app>9d C. D. F. uṣṭa nya. D. Gajamatta rodra.
1745</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="10"><l n="a">dhik hāh kamuṅ nṛpasutādhama bhāratāṅśa,</l>
.<l n="b">bhaṅgābhimāna juga tan tuhu sādhu dibya,*
.jambat vuvusmu parachidra mahāviveka,</l>
1750<l n="c">liṣyamu duṣṭa kuhakāmutuṅ iṅ kadi ṅvaṅ.</l>
. <!-- <app> * B. D. E. — 10b B. D. E. sādhu dibya. H. sādhu ra dibya. — 10c B. mahavivekā. C. F. mahaviveki. D. mahāvivekī.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="11"><l n="a">ndin vīrarāja vənaṅ adbhuta matyanāku,</l>
1755<l n="b">brahmārṣi viṣṇu ya kavəs suranātha kumyus,</l>
.<l n="c">hiṅanya saṅ prabhu kakanyu si dhātraputra,</l>
.<l n="d">hāh dūra rodra mihateki təkapku riṅ praṅ.</l>
.</lg>
.
1760</div>
.<div type="canto" rend="met" n="32" met="FILL-ME-IN">
.<lg n="1"><l n="a">nā liṅnyān matəmah trivikrama magə̄ṅ taṅ rūpa ghorāhirəṅ,</l>
.<l n="b">krūrāṅganya caturbhujāṅavaśakən* yān mūrti saṅ hyaṅ gaṇa,</l>
.<l n="c">sātus teka gaḍiṅnikāriṅiriṅi lvir mṛtyu sākṣāt murub,</l>
1765<l n="d">nāgendropama tulyaniṅ tulalay adbhūtā ta medhālaṅu.</l>
. <!-- <app> * C. D. G. H. — 1b A. caturbujakavasakən. — 1d B. tulalayatyadbhuta.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="2"><l n="a">muntab tejanikāgni kātara sakeṅ kumbhātirodrān kutug,</l>
1770<l n="b">mvaṅ saṅkeṅ mata sūryavimba dumilah mvaṅ bāyubajrāṅasut,</l>
.<l n="c">syuh bhasmyaṅ vanavṛkṣasattva katunu lvir parvatāgnyujjvala,</l>
.<l n="d">uṣṇaṅ svarga təkapnya durbala* salah dhyānaṅ vatək devata.</l>
. <!-- <app> * B. — 2c H. bhraṣṭaṅ. — 2d A. C. D. E. F. G. H. durbala.
.</app> -->
1775</lg>
.<lg n="3"><l n="a">tindak lvir bubulaṅ mahītala bəlah kombak vvay iṅ sāgara,</l>
.<l n="b">kālembaṅ kapalumbalumba mavərə̄ joṅ phalvarājān karəm,</l>
.<l n="c">meṅguṅ taṅ Imavan prakampa kadahut buṅkahnikaṅ Mandara,</l>
.<l n="d">gambhlraṅuluvuṅ katon natar ikaṅ nagendra mavrəg ta ya.</l>
1780 <!-- <app>3a B. bubula. — 3b B. D. kaklembaṅ kapəlumba-lumba. G. kaklekar. E. H. kaklembaṅ. E. kapilumba-lumba.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="4"><l n="a">ghorghoraṅ giri revatekana rubuh glānaṅ trilokākṣaya,</l>
.<l n="b">deniṅ krodhanikaṅ gajendramukha śabdātryaṅalun garvita,
1785āyāy kṣatriya pāpa duṣṭa lihatekiṅ hastivaktrādbhuta,</l>
.<l n="c">yadyan bhūmi sabhūrbhuvahsvah uyəṅən byaktātəmah sāgara.</l>
.</lg>
.<lg n="5"><l n="a">saṅsiptan laku pet kakanyu kətikaṅ śaktīṅ jagat kottama,</l>
.<l n="b">mvaṅ rāmanyu si hastinendra pinaṅən sakvehnikaṅ bhūpati,</l>
1790<l n="c">akvikyāmapageṅ raṇātakəra gə̄ṅniṅ krodha hārohara,</l>
.<l n="d">dhik tan durmukharūpa tāku yadiyan tan bhraṣṭa deṅkv iṅ raṇa.</l>
. <!-- <app>5b B. D. E. H. sakveh vatək bhūpati. — 5c B. akvīkyamapage.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
1795<lg n="6"><l n="a">nojar saṅ gaṇamūrti śīghra sumahur śrī hastinendrātmaja,</l>
.<l n="b">ai tandaṅ kamu koṅ prakopa vinarah riṅ dharmaśāstrottama,</l>
.<l n="c">jambat ṅvaṅ musirāśrayānuruhanaṅ* sāmantayodha prabhu,</l>
.<l n="d">bhoh pembuh śatakoṭi** hastivadanākun tan surud*** siṅ raṇa.</l>
. <!-- <app> * C. D. E. F. G. H. ** B. G. D. F. H. *** B. F. G. H. 6c A. musirāśrayānurunanaṅ. B. musirānuruhaṅ. — 6d A. E. G. pata koṭi. A. G. D. E. surut.
1800</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="7"><l n="a">liṅ śrī bhūpatiputra tan dvan umasə̄ taṅ durmukhāhyābhutəṅ,</l>
.<l n="b">sarvāstrādbhuta saṅka riṅ taṅan anekān śīghra sampun ləpas,*
.ndātan pamyati saṅ narendrasuta kagyat saṅ para ṛṣy aṅiriṅ,</l>
1805<l n="c">ṅkāne** dura vanān paṅanti ri sirārəs riṅ varāstraāṅavur.</l>
. <!-- <app> * B. C. D. E. G. ** B. C. E. F. — 7a B. durmukāhyādbhuteṅ. — 7b A. F. H. ləkas. — 7d A. D. G. H. ṅkāna.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="8"><l n="a">krodhekaṅ gajavaktra sambut ikanaṅ bhūh parvatāgrāśila,</l>
1810<l n="b">aṇḍəmyādbhuta bhasmibhūta ri harəp śrī bhūmināthātmaja,</l>
.<l n="c">sakvehniṅ vara sañjatātryasasaran lvir larvalarveṅ apuy,</l>
.<l n="d">deniṅ jñāna viśeṣa sandhi patulak bvatniṅ mahārorava.</l>
. <!-- <app>8a D. sāmbut.
.</app> -->
1815</lg>
.<lg n="9"><l n="a">maṅkin krodha bhaṭāra durmukha təkapniṅ parvatāstrān hilaṅ,</l>
.<l n="b">yekā hetunirātikāptya mususaṅ trailokya* bhūmi syuhən,</l>
.<l n="c">prodbhūteṅ luṅayan lumuṅ ya maṅavil vitniṅ kṣiti maviyat,**
.makrak saṅ para deva ghūrṇa lumihat mohūt i saṅ hyaṅ gaṇa.</l>
1820 <!-- <app> * B. C. D. E. H. ** B. — 9b A. F. G. muburaṅ triloka. — 9c A. C. D. E. F. G. H. kṣiti mvaṅ viyat. — 9d B. mākrak. H. deva ghūrṇṇita.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="10"><l n="a">lāvan saṅ sutasoma pinrih inivə̄ de saṅ vatək devatā,</l>
.<l n="b">jñānānuṅ pamisārja rodra tuturən liṅ hyaṅ surendrāvuvus,</l>
1825<l n="c">nāhan hetunirekacitta humənəṅ boddhyagrimudrāpagəh,</l>
.<l n="d">pohniṅ sattva mijil taṅ astrabhiduran saṅkeṅ svacittādbhuta.</l>
. <!-- <app>10d B. saṅke. D. astrabhidurān. H. astraviduran.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
1830<lg n="11"><l n="a">pūrṇaṅ teja baṅun śaśāṅka ri taṅan śrī hastinendrātmaja,</l>
.<l n="b">tempuhnye* ḍaḍa saṅ gajendramukha gək gər <app><lem>ghora</lem><rdg wit="#edss">ghyora</rdg></app> tan pamyati,</l>
.<l n="c">saṅkeṅ drəsnya savaṅ girīndra ḍumavuh puh tvasnikaṅ rākṣasa,</l>
.<l n="d">glānāṅlah juga tar vənaṅ malap ikaṅ bajra bvat aṅliṇḍihi.</l>
. <!-- <app> * D. E. G. — 11b A. B. G. H. təmpuh ne. D. pāmyati. F. təmpuh nyeṅ.
1835 ghora &lt;
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.
.</div>
1840<div type="canto" rend="met" n="33" met="FILL-ME-IN">
.<lg n="1"><l n="a">tan saṅkeṅ gəṅ iṅ astra hetunika yan rasa pəjaha vimūrcha kāsihan,</l>
.<l n="b">sampun tattva bhaṭāra rakva viṣāṇāmṛta pavarah i saṅ munīśvara,</l>
.<l n="c">sor tekaṅ visa denireṅ kujana tīrtha təmahanira riṅ mahārddhika,</l>
.<l n="d">yekā hetunikaṅ* gajendramukha tan papaḍa təkap i tībraniṅ lara.</l>
1845 <!-- <app> * B. D. E. — 1a A. C. F. G. H. hetu niraṅ.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="2"><l n="a">təkvan hyaṅ gaṇa rakva sah sira sakeṅ asura matutur iṅ kaśāntikan,</l>
.<l n="b">deniṅ jñāna viśeṣa śakti rumakut ri vuyuṅ ira rikaṅ jagat kabeh,</l>
1850<l n="c">lavan vruh sira yan narendrasuta buddhasakala magave jagaddhita,</l>
.<l n="d">nāhan hetunirān mulih saha lavan surapati sahadevatāṅdulur.</l>
. <!-- <app>2d B. devādulur.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
1855<lg n="3"><l n="a">ndan saṅ kāri vimohitāhənək apəg anaṅis* alara maminta jīvana,</l>
.<l n="b">ai saṅ śrī sutasoma piṇḍa hapa tāku matəlasana hiṅsakojjvala,</l>
.<l n="c">māna krodha kaṭuṅka tan huniṅanən tilarakna ri sattvaniṅ hati,</l>
.<l n="d">saṅkā yan laraniṅ manah bhidura dhāraṇa pəjah i lalista riṅ hulun.</l>
. <!-- <app> * B. C. D. E. G. — 3a A. F. H. arən naṅis.
1860</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="4"><l n="a">yekā hetunirān vavaṅ malap ikaṅ bhidura maluyi śuddhaniṅ manah,</l>
.<l n="b">śīghrānəmbah* ikaṅ gajendramukha bhaktya śikhara** ri ləbūni jə̄ṅnira,</l>
.<l n="c">paṇḍyāgurva ri saṅ narendrasuta liṅnika mamaha sukhe nṛpātmaja,</l>
1865<l n="d">yogābhyāsa rikaṅ girīndra tumute salakunira mahāyānabrata.</l>
. <!-- <app> * B. C. D. E. F. G. ** C. E. G. — 4b A. H. śīghrānambah. A. B. D. F. sikara ri. H. sira ri. — 4c H. paramasuke.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="5"><l n="a">ndan sakvehnira saṅ ṛṣi pramukha keśava ḍatəṅ i siraṅ nṛpātmaja,</l>
1870<l n="b">kapvāṅastuti dibya saṅ nṛpatiputra sakala jinamūrti riṅ sarāt,</l>
.<l n="c">tan varṇan ri huvusnireki nṛpaputra mamisiki ri saṅ mahāsura,</l>
.<l n="d">jñānānusmṛtiśāsaneki pavarahnira ya sapavarahniṅ āgama.</l>
. <!-- <app>6b C. nṛpatiputra jñānānusmṛti.
.</app> -->
1875</lg>
.<lg n="6"><l n="a">byātītan ri huvusnirāmisiki saṅ gajamukha ri katattvan iṅ dadi,</l>
.<l n="b">lampah śrī nṛpaputra yeka caritan sira lumaku lavan munīśvara,</l>
.<l n="c">ndan saṅ sāmajavaktra tan sah aṅiriṅ ri sira manusup iṅ vanāntara,</l>
.<l n="d">groṅ durgārəs ikaṅ kalakvan i ləpitləpit i siluk ikaṅ gunuṅ midər.</l>
1880 <!-- <app>6d C. i ləpit i siluk.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="7"><l n="a">kañcit rakva haneki nāgapati kādbhuta təka sakiṅ agraparvata,</l>
.<l n="b">ṅākṅāk śabda nikāharəp mamaṅane nṛpasuta dinunuṅnya gə̄ṅ galak,</l>
1885<l n="c">yatnekaṅ gajavaktra yāṅalaṅakən tanu pinuliṅan* iṅ mahābhaya,</l>
.<l n="d">ghoraṅ haṅga saparvatāgra binəbədniṅ uraga giri mandaropama.</l>
. <!-- <app> * C. D. E. F. H. — 7c A. pinulaṅan. B. pinuləṅan.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
1890<lg n="8"><l n="a">krūrekān manahut manəmbur i mukhendriya gajamukha śuddha niścala,</l>
.<l n="b">bāyvagnyardhana yeka pasaṅən ya guməsəṅana nāgabandhana,</l>
.<l n="c">he saṅ durmukha hayva maṅkana vuvus nṛpasuta kalavan munīśvara,</l>
.<l n="d">tan dadyaṅ muni bauddhapakṣa satatāmatimati makabuddhi maṅkana.</l>
. <!-- <app>8b B. siddha pasaṅən guməsəṅana. C. siddha yeka pasaṅən. D. E. F. H. siddhi yeka pasaṅən. — 8d B. tan dadya.
1895</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="9"><l n="a">āpan rakva bhaṭāra sira sattva karuṇa sahaneṅ jagattraya,</l>
.<l n="b">yadyan śatru təkapnireki juga tan pinəjahan ika* kevala həniṅ,</l>
.<l n="c">jñānāveśa minuṣṭi rakva makaśastra** pasukakən i cittaniṅ musuh,</l>
1900<l n="d">byaktaṅ krodha mamūrti sattva manukūla təkapiṅ atipaṇḍiteṅ manah.</l>
. <!-- <app> * B. C. D. E. H. ** E. — 9b A. F. G. ira. — 9c A. B. G. D. F. G. H. makasastra.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="10"><l n="a">yekā rakva tinūtniraṅ sugatapakṣa satata magave jagaddhita,</l>
1905<l n="b">ton ṅūnī ṅvaṅ gə̄ṅta rudrasakaleṅ guṇa mahəli kaśāntan uttama,</l>
.<l n="c">maṅkā teki kabuddhya saṅ gajamukhāṅlavanaṅ uraga śakti digjaya,</l>
.<l n="d">sambyan rakva parīkṣanən gati jinasmaraṇa karaṇaniṅ jayeṅ raṇa.</l>
. <!-- <app>10a C. D. yekān rakva.
.</app> -->
1910</lg>
.<lg n="11"><l n="a">nāhan liṅ jinamūrti durmukha rikātutur i sapavəkasnireṅ* daṅū,</l>
.<l n="b">sampun rakva ləpas manahnya yugapat mamarəṅi ri manah nṛpātmaja,</l>
.<l n="c">kapvārok mapisan təkeṅ bhujaga padma hṛdaya sira jīvahāraka,</l>
.<l n="d">glānaṅ nāga vimūrcha kesəp anibeṅ kṣiti malupa ri dagdhaniṅ hati.</l>
1915 <!-- <app> *F. — 11a A. B. C. D. E. G. H. i pavəkas.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.
.</div>
1920<div type="canto" rend="met" n="34" met="FILL-ME-IN">
.<lg n="1"><l n="a">vəkasan ta* yāṅlilir i sampun ika mahəli citta sattvika,</l>
.<l n="b">aharəp subhaktya ri gajendramukha liṅika dharmamūrtika,</l>
.<l n="c">gajavaktra śīghra matulak tumuduhakən i saṅ nṛpātmaja,</l>
.<l n="d">sira teki saṅ humuripī kita sakala viśeṣa paṇḍita.</l>
1925 <!-- <app> * C. D. E. F. G. — 1a A. B. H. tan yaṅlilir.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="2"><l n="a">ya tinūtnya yan praṇata bhakti ri suku jinamūrti <app><lem>sādara</lem><rdg wit="#edss">sāḍara</rdg></app> ,</l>
.<l n="b">gajavaktra harṣaja mihat milu musapi ləbūni jə̄ṅnira,</l>
1930<l n="c">karuhun maharṣi paḍa mastuti ri sira təkapnya śāntika,</l>
.<l n="d">kavəṅan turnon ri kamahātmyanira tuhu bhaṭāra riṅ jagat.</l>
.</lg>
.<lg n="3"><l n="a">avivakṣiteki laku saṅ nṛpasuta vuvusən kathākna,</l>
.<l n="b">təka riṅ juraṅ mayukaparvata kayu vək i sək nirantara,</l>
1935<l n="c">paṅikāvilət lumalay iṅ havan amuhara saṅhub iṅ vukir,</l>
.<l n="d">matəmah pətəṅ ri təkaniṅ limut amaḍəmi tīkṣṇaniṅ ravi.</l>
. <!-- <app> * F. — 3a B. F. avivakṣiteki. H. avivakṣa teki.
. mayukaparvata: em. mayukhaparvata, m.c. for mayūkhaparvata?
.</app> -->
1940</lg>
.<lg n="4"><l n="a">gunuṅ adbhutāsəmu mahāsura katəmu ri madhyaniṅ vana,</l>
.<l n="b">matutuk guhālva masiyuṅ kəpuh aruhur aṅanti riṅ gəgər,</l>
.<l n="c">mata tulya bhāskara śilāputih akalaṅan iṅ gunuṅ midər,</l>
.<l n="d">masavit latāgəṅ aṅurambat i paraṅanikaṅ mahāgiri.</l>
1945</lg>
.<lg n="5"><l n="a">baḍamanya megha ri ruhur luṅayanika kuvuṅkuvuṅ pəluk,</l>
.<l n="b">saha bāyubajra kumusuh kadi lakunika* rodra gə̄ṅ galak,</l>
.<l n="c">vəkasan mirirmirirakən kusuma teki ri jə̄ṅ nṛpātmaja,</l>
.<l n="d">kadi səmbahanya tumūtaṅiriṅa kadi gajendravaktra ya.</l>
1950 <!-- <app> * C. E. H. — 5b A. B. D. F. G. nira
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="6"><l n="a">i təpinya sumbər umijil məsat asəmu ririsnya kāṅinan,</l>
.<l n="b">bana sattvarāja ri samīpanika vahu mijil sakeṅ guhā,</l>
1955<l n="c">maharəp mamuktya ri vəkanya dinəmak ika mepu kāsihan,</l>
.<l n="d">makədalkədal manaṅis ahyun umura ya gupay katiṇḍihan.</l>
.</lg>
.<lg n="7"><l n="a">nṛpaputra tan dva lumihat sira tumuluy aśabda vākpaṭu,</l>
.<l n="b">mṛganātha he bibi huvus juga hilahila hayva maṅkana,</l>
1960<l n="c">tuvi tan vaneh vəka təkapta tan iku* makamāṅsabhakṣaka,</l>
.<l n="d">putus iṅ kaduryaśan ikuṅ pati niyata təkaṅ upadrava.</l>
. <!-- <app> * D. H. — 7b E. huvus hila-hila kita hayva. — 7c A. H. hamiku. C. E. aniku.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
1965<lg n="8"><l n="a">tuvi nora pāpa kadi pāpaniṅ anak atiduṣṭa riṅ yayah,</l>
.<l n="b">gurutalpeki ya paḍanya niyata təka riṅ yamālaya,</l>
.<l n="c">ndan alah kapāpanika karva təkap i laku saṅ mṛgādhipa,</l>
.<l n="d">ṅka <app><lem>suhaśra</lem><rdg type="emn">sahasra?</rdg></app> koṭi kəta pāpanika ya pavarahniṅ āgama.</l>
. <!-- <app>8d C. E. F. teka.
1970</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="9"><l n="a">kalavan ta yeka hana dharmavacana sutakīrtya riṅ jagat,</l>
.<l n="b">talagādikūpa surayajña janayaśa kasor təkapnika,</l>
.<l n="c">apa yan vənaṅ gumavayaṅ kriya saguṇaniṅ ātmajottama,</l>
1975<l n="d">karuhun kasaṅkalan ikaṅ bapa bibi ya ləpas nirātmaka.</l>
. <!-- <app>9b G. nira. — 9c B. C. D. E. H. tryaśaguṇa. G. apa tan vənaṅ.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="10"><l n="a">iti nā vuvus nṛpatiputran umuhuti rikaṅ mṛgādhipa,</l>
1980<l n="b">mṛgasiṅha yatna sumahur i vacananira saṅ nṛpātmaja,</l>
.<l n="c">vruh ike ṅhulun ri guṇa doṣaniṅ inucapakənta yogyana,</l>
.<l n="d">ṅhiṅ ateki mogha kavahan lapa karaṇaniṅ iṅsakātmaja.</l>
. <!-- <app>10a H. sumayut i. — 10d G. nikīṅsakātmaja.
.</app> -->
1985</lg>
.<lg n="11"><l n="a">akire vaneh ṅvaṅ iki tan hana kavənaṅ ikiṅ mṛgeṅ vana,</l>
.<l n="b">pramukhaṅ <app><lem>kənas</lem><rdg wit="#edss">kəṇas</rdg></app> kapi lutuṅ vijuṅ ika sama durbalālayu,</l>
.<l n="c">ṅūniveh ta saṅ tapa kavəs girigirin i kamūrtiniṅ hulun,</l>
.<l n="d">karaṇaṅku yan suta subhojana ri pamatək iṅ hilālapa.</l>
1990 <!-- <app>11c H. kamūrkkan i ṅhulun. — 11d C. suka subhojana.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="12"><l n="a">śubhavākya maṅkana rikā nṛpasuta saha lūh nirantara,</l>
.<l n="b">siliḍirya* rakva kaharəpnira matalaṅa jīva sakṣaṇa,</l>
1995<l n="c">taḍahənya tan** svaṅa lamun mahuripa vəkani mṛgādhipa,</l>
.<l n="d">paramārtha dharmaṅ usirən karuṇā ri laraniṅ nirāśraya.</l>
. <!-- <app> * C. D. E. F. G. H. ** C. D. E. F. G. H. — 12b A. B. silinirrya. — 12c A. B. yan svaṅa.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
2000
.</div>
.<div type="canto" rend="met" n="35" met="FILL-ME-IN">
.<lg n="1"><l n="a">nāhan liṅ saṅ narendrātmaja paramasukhāmbəknikaṅ sattvanātha,</l>
.<l n="b">tan dvodanyāṅhuvakən vəkanika malajəṅ muṅsir iṅ deśa durga,
2005āmhām yan ton siraṅ bhāratakula paməpəgniṅ vayah yovanānvam,</l>
.<l n="c">hetunyār aṅsə̄* yan garjita madəg i harəp śrī mahārājaputra.</l>
. <!-- <app> * S. — 1d A. G. D. F. G. H. hetu nyār aṅsa. B. E. hetunyar aṅga.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
2010<lg n="2"><l n="a">prodbhūtaṅ hakṣi mūlyar siyuṅ ika maluṅid katarāṅapnikālva,</l>
.<l n="b">karvaṅ hastātitīkṣṇāriṅiriṅi rumakut <app><lem>ry aṅga</lem><rdg wit="#edss">ryyāṅa</rdg></app> saṅ nāthaputra,</l>
.<l n="c">mumbul saṅkeṅ jajādrəs gətihira cinucup denikaṅ sattvanātha,</l>
.<l n="d">glānāṅlah citta <app><lem>nirvāṇa</lem><rdg wit="#edss">nirbbāna</rdg></app> * ya rinəgepirān mantukeṅ buddhaloka.</l>
. <!-- <app> * B. C. D. G. H. — 2a B. D. E. aksi. — 2d A. F. glānāṅlah nirbāṇa. E. citta nirbāṇa. E. boddhaloka.
2015</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="3"><l n="a">ndan saṅ <app><lem>hastīndravaktra</lem><rdg wit="#edss">hastīnendravaktra</rdg></app> mvaṅ uraga kalavan keśava glānacitta,</l>
.<l n="b">kepvan deniṅ manah tan vənaṅ asayut i saṅ śrī mahārājaputra,
.āpan sampun purih saṅ kumavaśakən ikaṅ bodhisattvopadeśa,*
2020tulyekāmbəknirānuṅ pəjaha mahuripāṅhiṅ yaśāvṛddhi mūlya.</l>
. <!-- <app> * B. C. E. F. G. H. — 3a H. hastīndravaktra raga makamukha saṅ Keśava. — 3c A. D. ikaṅ satvopadeśa.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="4"><l n="a">byātītan līna saṅ śrī jinakula pinaṅan denikaṅ sattvanātha,</l>
2025<l n="b">liṇḍū taṅ bhūmi tan kram hyaṅ aruṇa malara lvirnirāṅdoh maṅulvan,</l>
.<l n="c">tan śobhaṅ byoma kadyāṅəmu taṅis i təḍuhniṅ <app><lem>ghanāsaṅhub</lem><rdg wit="#edss">ghyaṇāsaṅhub</rdg></app> aṅluh,</l>
.<l n="d">gəntərnyāsambasambat kilat asəmu kəḍapniṅ təñuh katīkṣṇan.</l>
. <!-- <app>4d B. C. E. F. G. təñuh mār katīkṣṇan.
.</app> -->
2030</lg>
.<lg n="5"><l n="a">lāvan saṅ sattvanāthāsəmu kahuvan* i pəjah śrī mahārājaputra,</l>
.<l n="b">deniṅ rah kesəp ardhāmṛta mamarəgi garbhāmaṅun <app><lem>śāntacitta</lem><rdg wit="#edss">śāntācitta</rdg></app> ,</l>
.<l n="c">maṅkin kaṅən varah saṅ munivara sira yan rājasunvānivārya,</l>
.<l n="d">hetunyan bhakti tan sah manaṅis iri dagan saṅ mahānāthaputra.</l>
2035 <!-- <app> * D. E. G. H. — 5a A. F. kavuhan. B. rahuvan. C. kavuvan. — 5c C. yan bhāja.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="6"><l n="a">hāhāh he bhūmināthātmaja pahurip atah saṅ mahābodhisattva,</l>
.<l n="b">tiṅhalte duhkhaniṅ kaśmala mamati tuhanta nyatāḍaṇḍa doṣa,</l>
2040<l n="c">āpan byaktekanaṅ pāpa tumuvuh asəvə̄ vəltik iṅ mānakarma,</l>
.<l n="d">lud ṅvaṅ sattvātimūḍhācəmər aku riṅ apan tan təkeṅ roravāṅga.</l>
.</lg>
.<lg n="7"><l n="a">saṅsiptan piṇḍaha pvaṅhulun atəlasana dveṣa riṅ putradharma,</l>
.<l n="b">maryāṅgə̄ṅ krodha maryāṅapakaṅapaka riṅ saṅ mahāpaṇḍitāgra,*</l>
2045<l n="c">yapvan saṅke lalis saṅ nṛpatanaya təhər matya tan labdhajīvan,</l>
.<l n="d">milva ṅvaṅ līna vetniṅ taya maṅinakaneṅ hiṅsakā buddhi pāpa.</l>
. <!-- <app> * E. — 7b A. B. C. D. F. G. H. mahāpaṇḍitāgra. — 7d F. mātya vet.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
2050</div>
.<div type="canto" rend="met" n="36" met="FILL-ME-IN">
.<lg n="1"><l n="a">nā liṅ mṛgendrāvacane nṛpātmaja,</l>
.<l n="b">ndan dūra rakvāhuripāṅ huvus pəjah,</l>
.<l n="c">sattvendra yekāmrih aminta patyana,</l>
2055<l n="d">de hastivaktroraga mukhya saṅ ṛṣi.</l>
.</lg>
.<lg n="2"><l n="a">ndan saṅ śinabdan sira teki <app><lem>laṅghana</lem><rdg wit="#edss">laṅghyana</rdg></app> ,</l>
.<l n="b">puh tvasnirān kevala duhkhitānaṅis,</l>
.<l n="c">sattvendra dhīrāptya tumārjanaṅ tanu,</l>
2060<l n="d">dīptaṅ nakāṅhiṅ pvaṅ iniṣṭi pālaga.</l>
. <!-- <app>2c C. humarjjanaṅ.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="3"><l n="a">ndah hyaṅ surendrādhipa riṅ surālaya,</l>
2065<l n="b">prāpteki tan dvohuti saṅ mṛgeśvara,</l>
.<l n="c">bhoh he kitaṅ moṅ bibi hayva maṅkana,</l>
.<l n="d">nyātāku hetvanyāhurip* nṛpātmaja.</l>
. <!-- <app> * B. C. — 3a E. ndan saṅ. — 3d A. D. F. G. hetvaṅ mahurip. E. hetu nya hurip. H. hetva ni hurip.
.</app> -->
2070</lg>
.<lg n="4"><l n="a">maṅkā ta vākśabdaniraṅ surādhipa,</l>
.<l n="b">dhyāyī kṣaṇa śrī nṛpaputra maṅlilir,</l>
.<l n="c">buddhasmṛti pvaṅ vinibhajya riṅ śava,</l>
.<l n="d">mvaṅ pañcabāyvardhana saṅkaniṅ hurip.</l>
2075 <!-- <app>4c H. vini bhāgya.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="5"><l n="a">pūrṇaṅ śarīreki muvah kadīṅ daṅū,</l>
.<l n="b">lvir supta polahnira tekyamār baṅun,</l>
2080<l n="c">ṅka taṅ macan bhakti ri jə̄ṅ nṛpātmaja,</l>
.<l n="d">mvaṅ hastivaktroraga tuṣṭa saṅ ṛṣi.</l>
.</lg>
.<lg n="6"><l n="a">ndan śrī narendrātmaja mepu suṅkava,*</l>
.<l n="b">maṅke ri jīvānira de śatakratu,</l>
2085<l n="c">lvir dāna riṅ vah dhana ratna kāñcana.</l>
.<l n="d">tambosadhīṅ aṅga sulakṣaṇottama.**</l>
. <!-- <app>* B. D. E. F. H. ** B. F. G. — 6a A. G. G. suṅkavan. — 8c B. lvir ddāna. — 8d A. C. D. E. H. salakṣaṇottama</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="7"><l n="a">āpan tikaṅ vvaṅ matakut ya riṅ pati,</l>
2090<l n="b">lūd tar vruh iṅ mārga viśeṣaṅ uṅsirən,</l>
.<l n="c">tṛṣṇeṅ hanak mvaṅ putu patnikāṅlare,</l>
.<l n="d">yogyan huripnyān tuluṅən surādhipa.</l>
.</lg>
.<lg n="8"><l n="a">ṅvaṅ teki dūrān hana mātra tolihən,</l>
2095<l n="b">tyāgeṅ hurip dharma viśeṣa mūlya ya,</l>
.<l n="c">niṣkāraṇolah suranātha riṅ hulun,</l>
.<l n="d">gə̄ṅ bañcanāmbək tunadharma kevala.</l>
.</lg>
.<lg n="9"><l n="a">nāhan vuvus saṅ nṛpaputra maṅkana,</l>
2100<l n="b">ai śrī narendrātmaja liṅ surādhipa,</l>
.<l n="c">sihteṅ mahāsattva jagaddhitenapi,</l>
.<l n="d">donkv āmalaṅ ri prakṛtinta yan pəjah.</l>
. <!-- <app>9 B. donkun malaṅ</app> -->
.</lg>
2105<lg n="10"><l n="a">ṅūnī pəjahteki təkap mṛgeśvara,</l>
.<l n="b">vəlasterikaṅ moṅ suta seṣṭiniṅ hati,</l>
.<l n="c">līnanta yeka mṛganātha matya* ya,**
.patyanya nirdon karuṇanta riṅ jagat.</l>
. <!-- <app> * B. ** C. D. E. H. — 10c A. F. G. matyana. B. mātya. G. D. E. H. mātya ya. — 10d B. matya.
2110</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="11"><l n="a">jīvānta maṅke paramārtha riṅ sarat,</l>
.<l n="b">jīvānikaṅ sattva mahāsukheṅ manah,</l>
.<l n="c">yāvat pəjah saṅ nṛpaputra riṅ vana,</l>
2115<l n="d">tāvat pəjah taṅ mṛgasattva tan kasah.</l>
.</lg>
.
.</div>
.<div type="canto" rend="met" n="37" met="FILL-ME-IN">
2120<lg n="1"><l n="a">saṅkṣepanya ya hetuniṅ vavaṅ anindya humuripi kita,</l>
.<l n="b">tan saṅkeṅ vara bañcanāṅalaṅi dontan umaluya jinā,</l>
.<l n="c">dharmānūta ri sihta riṅ sakalasattva ya karaṇa təmən,</l>
.<l n="d">astam jīvananiṅ jagat ri təkaniṅ bhuvana haruhara.</l>
.</lg>
2125<lg n="2"><l n="a">liṅ saṅ hyaṅ suranātha riṅ kṣaṇa milag sira tatan ucapən,</l>
.<l n="b">somyāmbək sutasoma deni paṅucapniran aməlasakən,</l>
.<l n="c">mvaṅ sakvehnira saṅ ṛṣi pramukha keśava ta paḍa sukha,</l>
.<l n="d">durvaktroraga sattvanātha karuhun rəna ri Surapati.</l>
.</lg>
2130
.</div>
.<div type="canto" rend="met" n="38" met="FILL-ME-IN">
.<lg n="1"><l n="a">sattvendroraga tika mukhya hastivaktra,</l>
.<l n="b"><app><lem>bhaktyāṅañjali</lem><rdg wit="#edss">bhyaktyāṅañjali</rdg></app> ri siraṅ narendraputra,</l>
2135<l n="c">kapvāminta vinarah iṅ mahopadeśa,</l>
.<l n="d">dvārānuṅ tutən iṅ acintya śūnyamārga.</l>
. <!-- <app>1d G. D. F. śūnyadharmma.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
2140<lg n="2"><l n="a">āpan kveh i manah i saṅ mahātiyogi,</l>
.<l n="b">vvantən nirmalabhava mokṣakān ginə̄ṅ tvas,</l>
.<l n="c">len taṅ tyāga pəjah anuṅ ya teṣṭadharma,</l>
.<l n="d">paṅliṅgan nṛpasuta naṣṭa maṅkya mūlya.</l>
. <!-- <app>2c H. teṣṭidharma. — 2d H. maṅke.
2145</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="3"><l n="a">saṅsiptan ləvih ikanaṅ paratramārga,</l>
.<l n="b">saṅkeṅ mokṣaka ri hiḍəp patik narārya,</l>
.<l n="c">ḍū bhāgyādhika paṅucapta sādhu riṅ rat,</l>
2150<l n="d">ādya ṅvaṅ majara masākṣya saṅ ṛṣīndra.*</l>
. <!-- <app>* D. — 3a H. paratradharmma. — 3d A. B. C. E. F. G. H. rəṣindra. D. adyā.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="4"><l n="a">siṅgih liṅta paramamokṣa mārgadibya,</l>
2155<l n="b">deniṅ rāt kunaṅ ika saṅ mahātividvan,</l>
.<l n="c">tan mokṣāṅga juga viśeṣa dharma mārga,</l>
.<l n="d">matyāsiṅ saparāganiṅ kabodhisattvan.</l>
. <!-- <app>4b D. mahātividhvān.
.</app> -->
2160</lg>
.<lg n="5"><l n="a">pə̄hniṅ śāstra təkap i saṅ viśeṣa sādhu,</l>
.<l n="b">yadyan pāləha sukha yan parārtha donya,</l>
.<l n="c">durlakṣmyāthava sugiheki tan vikalpa,</l>
.<l n="d">mon matyāhuripa lamun jagaddhitārtha.</l>
2165 <!-- <app>5b H. ya saṅləha sukha yan parārtha don.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="6"><l n="a">ṅhiṅ tekaṅ paramanirasrayeki goṅen,</l>
.<l n="b">riṅ jñānadhika vəkas iṅ mahāviśeṣa,</l>
2170<l n="c">tan svargabyudaya kitan* paṅekacitta,</l>
.<l n="d">yekaṅde sasar ikanaṅ paratramārga.</l>
. <!-- <app> * D. E. H. — 6C A. B. F. G. siran paṅekacitta. G. svargabyudayaka tan paṅekacitta.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
2175<lg n="7"><l n="a">toh ndyānuṅ vivitan ike liṅanta maṅko,</l>
.<l n="b">vidyādi krama ginəlar təkap bhaṭāra,</l>
.<l n="c">dharmādharma tuvuh ikeṅ samastabhūmi,</l>
.<l n="d">mati mvaṅ mahurip aneka sṛṣṭiniṅ vvaṅ.</l>
. <!-- <app>7c C. D. E. ikaṅ samāsta. E. dharmmādharmmātuvuh.
2180</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="8"><l n="a">pūjā yoga japa samādhi dāna puṇya,</l>
.<l n="b">len tekaṅ brata śucipakṣa bhairavātva,</l>
.<l n="c">salvirnyaṅ* aśubha śubha pravṛtti riṅ** rāt,</l>
2185<l n="d">jñānāveśa milu tumūt punarbhaveka.</l>
. <!-- <app> * B. C. D. ** B. D. F. G. H. — 8b C. Bhairava. — 8c A. E. F. G. H. neṅ. A. G. E.niṅ. — 8d C. jñānāvīṣa.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.
2190</div>
.<div type="canto" rend="met" n="39" met="FILL-ME-IN">
.<lg n="1"><l n="a">kunaṅ saṅ vvaṅ niśśreyasa sira tatan siddhi riṅ ulah,</l>
.<l n="b">ndātan pūjā tan yoga rinəgəpirānisbhava sadā,</l>
.<l n="c">luput saṅkeṅ bhavakrama pati hurip tan paṅavara,</l>
2195<l n="d">apan sākṣāt saṅkan paran ika sirācintyabhavana.</l>
.</lg>
.<lg n="2"><l n="a">sirekādṛvya jñāna tiga hurip iṅ bhūmi sahana,</l>
.<l n="b">baṅun phalveṅ vvay tan milu bañu sireṅ duhkha sukha len,</l>
.<l n="c">guṇanekālit tan ləga masək iṅ alvādbhuta təmən,</l>
2200<l n="d">agə̄ṅ tan mopək mañjiṅ iṅ ahət ikā sūkṣma sumilib.</l>
. <!-- <app>2a C. jñānati hurip. — 2b B. C. D. E. H. bhayeṅ vvay. H. tan mina bañu sireṅ. — 2d B. C. D. gə̄ṅ tan mopək yan mañjiṅ.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="3"><l n="a">kaliṅhanyevəh saṅ vinuvus i vuvusniṅ vaṅ amuvus,</l>
2205<l n="b">apan rakvekin tan vənaṅ inubhayān pan sira mucap,</l>
.<l n="c">sirānon tan kāton sira juga manon pan sira manon,</l>
.<l n="d">adoh tan dūra ṅke sira ta maparək tan kaparəkan.</l>
. <!-- <app>3a B. C. vvaṅ. — 3b H. inucap pan sira mucap.
.</app> -->
2210</lg>
.<lg n="4"><l n="a">yatekā pinrihniṅ viku ri təkāniṅ dharma kapatin,</l>
.<l n="b">savaṅ kris sah saṅkeṅ saruṅan inunus tan kavaraṇān,</l>
.<l n="c">təkapniṅ trinyārok rva pinasah ireṅ jñāna vimala,</l>
.<l n="d">vidagdhāniṅkap roma salaya tinūtniṅ nirupana.</l>
2215 <!-- <app>4b B. E. H. kahavaran.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="5"><l n="a">acintyānumpak riṅ taya matapakan bhāskara vulan,</l>
.<l n="b">ikā lvir saṅ līnādhika sama lavan mokṣakaraṇa,</l>
2220<l n="c">nda saṅsiptan siṅ solaha juga lamun nirmala sadā,</l>
.<l n="d">prasiddhāmor iṅ tan hana kaluput iṅ <app><lem>vāhyavibhava</lem><rdg wit="#edss">vāhyu vibhava</rdg></app> .</l>
. <!-- <app>5d E. vāhya</app> -->
.</lg>
.
2225</div>
.<div type="canto" rend="met" n="40" met="FILL-ME-IN">
.<lg n="1"><l n="a">nāhan liṅ jinamūrti mājar i kadibyaniṅ patipati,</l>
.<l n="b">mvaṅ taṅ mokṣakamārga kempən i vuvusnirān pavacana,</l>
.<l n="c">ndan saṅ sāmajavaktra nāgapati sattvanātha karuṇa,</l>
2230<l n="d">bhaktyāṅañjali jə̄ṅnirāmalaku sihnireki tulusa.</l>
. <!-- <app>1a C. mojar.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="2"><l n="a">deniṅ yoga samādhi tan hana ri saṅ nirāśrayayati,</l>
2235<l n="b">nis taṅ mārga viśeṣa rakva ri hiḍəp patik nṛpasuta,</l>
.<l n="c">siddhaṅ yoga yan ardha liṅnira nirāśrayeki kahiḍəp,</l>
.<l n="d">nəm kvehnyādhika riṅ śivatva ya rəṅə̄n mahottama təmən.</l>
.</lg>
.<lg n="3"><l n="a">pratyāhāra ṅaranya* kālapan iṅ indriyeka vinalat,</l>
2240<l n="b">saṅkeṅ artha jugeka rakva makamārga buddhi vimala,</l>
.<l n="c">nyaṅ dhyānādhika dhīra yoga humiḍəp svasādhya mapagəh,</l>
.<l n="d">dibyāmoha taman kasambi riṅ ulah prapañca satata.</l>
. <!-- <app> * B. C. D. E. H. — 3a A. F. G. kala nya kālapan. — 3c H. pva satya mapagəh.
.</app> -->
2245</lg>
.<lg n="4"><l n="a">prāṇāyāma ṅaranya bāyu vinatək mareṅ hulu təṅah,</l>
.<l n="b">sarvadvāra minəb təkapnya tinūt iṅ viśeṣa katəmu,</l>
.<l n="c"><app><lem>oṁkāra</lem><rdg wit="#edss">aṁ kāra</rdg></app> praṇaveki muṅgu ri daləm tvas ardha ya kasə̄k,</l>
.<l n="d">vetniṅ tattva śivatva dhāraṇa ṅaranya yoga saphala.</l>
2250 <!-- <app>4b B. təkap tinut i viśeṣa.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="5"><l n="a">len taṅ tarka ṅaranya yoga gaganopamaṅ manohava,*</l>
.<l n="b">ṅhiṅ tan vāk dhara rakva len ika sake rikaṅ avaṅavaṅ,</l>
2255<l n="c">mvaṅ taṅ jñāna vikalpa tārja malilaṅ visādhya pinələṅ,</l>
.<l n="d">nissandeha samādhi yoga paṅaranya mokṣakaraṇa.</l>
. <!-- <app> * H. — 5a H. manohava.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
2260<lg n="6"><l n="a">tan dvāṅ aṣṭaguṇān kapaṅgih i təkapnya rakva karuhun,</l>
.<l n="b">dṛśyādṛśya vaśitva riṅ bhuvana rudramūrti sakala,</l>
.<l n="c">yekāṅbvat i manahniraṅ paramaśāntikārya nipuṇa,</l>
.<l n="d">kempər yan rusit iṅ jitendriya juraṅniṅ ambək ahajə̄ṅ.</l>
. <!-- <app>6b E. riṅ bhūmina. — 6c C. yekāṅlvat. paramaśākti kāryya</app> -->
2265</lg>
.<lg n="7"><l n="a">yapvan dhīra manahta tuṅgəṅ ikanaṅ svacitta mabənər,</l>
.<l n="b">tan kevəh təkap iṅ trikāya vala siddhi sarvakaraṇa,</l>
.<l n="c">kevəhniṅ triguṇātmakārdha ya huvus kasimpən amatəh,</l>
.<l n="d">ṅkā rakvān sira śūnyarūpa paramārthatattva kahiḍəp.</l>
2270 <!-- <app>7a C. manah katuṅgəṅ.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.
.</div>
2275<div type="canto" rend="met" n="41" met="FILL-ME-IN">
.<lg n="1"><l n="a">nāhan tiṅkah ikaṅ śivatva ri siraṅ śaiva svapakṣādhika,</l>
.<l n="b">bheda mvaṅ jinatattva teki ri siraṅ bauddhāprameyeṅ jagat,</l>
.<l n="c">saṅ hyaṅ advayayogasandhi pinakeṣṭidvāra saṅ bhikṣuka,</l>
.<l n="d">aṁ ah śabdanikaṅ svabāyu ri daləm kaṇṭha prasiddhaṅ hayu.</l>
2280 <!-- <app>1b B. F. H. boddhāpramayeṅ. H. rakva ri siraṅ.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="2"><l n="a">rəp prāptaṅ ravi soma denya sumaput riṅ deha śuddhākṛti,</l>
.<l n="b">mvaṅ taṅ advayacitta divya mapagəh ṅkāne manah nirbhaya,</l>
2285<l n="c">pə̄hniṅ rvānupamātiśīghra ri vijil hyaṅ buddha tan kāvaran,</l>
.<l n="d">śūnyākāra devāṅga nirmala sirān nirbāṇa nirlakṣaṇa.</l>
. <!-- <app>2b B. nir mmaya. — 2c E. kavaran.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
2290<lg n="3"><l n="a">āpan tan śiva tan maheśvara sirān tan brahma tan keśava,</l>
.<l n="b">tan saṅ hyaṅ parameṣṭhirudra tuduhən dūrān kavastverikā,</l>
.<l n="c">siṅgih yan paramārthabuddha təmahan saṅ siddha yogīśvara,</l>
.<l n="d">icchā nora kasaṅśayāganal alit tanmātra mātreṅ sarāt.</l>
. <!-- <app>3a C. sira tan.
2295</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="4"><l n="a">nāhan hetu bhaṭāra buddha kahiḍəp putrāprameyeṅ jagat,</l>
.<l n="b">saṅ hyaṅ advaya rāma tattvanira de saṅ paṇḍitāṅhayvani,</l>
.<l n="c">prajñāparimitebu tan sah i səḍəṅniṅ yoga sānusmṛti,</l>
2300<l n="d">tan rāgodaya <app><lem>bhinna</lem><rdg wit="#edss">bhīna</rdg></app> rakva kalavan hyaṅ durmukheṅātmaja.</l>
. <!-- <app>4a B. putrāpramayeṅ.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="5"><l n="a">maṅkā śīlanireṅ mahāyana vəkasniṅ bodhisattvān laku,</l>
2305<l n="b">vetniṅ tattva viśeṣa tan huniṅa riṅ <app><lem>aṣṭeśvarānindita</lem><rdg wit="#edss">asteśvarāniṇḍita</rdg></app> ,*
.yāvat prokṣaka rakva tāvat ikanaṅ niśśreyaseveh pinet,</l>
.<l n="c">nāhan hetuniraṅ śivatva makaḍat muṅsyāmriheṅ śūnyata.</l>
. <!-- <app> * B. C. D. E. H. — 5b A. F. G. haṣṭasvarānindita. — 5d B. D. E. H. ni saṅ śīvatva
.</app> -->
2310</lg>
.
.</div>
.<div type="canto" rend="met" n="42" met="FILL-ME-IN">
.<lg n="1"><l n="a">saṅsipta teki bapa saṅ gajavaktrarūpa,</l>
2315<l n="b">mvaṅ nāgarāja karuhun vara sattvanātha,</l>
.<l n="c">prih hayva tan dugaduge vuvus iṅ kadi ṅvaṅ,</l>
.<l n="d">buddhopadeśa təka riṅ śivatattvayoga.</l>
. <!-- <app>1a D. saṅsipteki.
.</app> -->
2320</lg>
.
.<lg n="2"><l n="a">āpan tivas juga siraṅ muni bauddhapakṣa,</l>
.<l n="b">yan tan vruh iṅ paramatattva śivatvamārga,</l>
.<l n="c">maṅkāṅ munīndra saṅ apaksa śivatvayoga,</l>
2325<l n="d">yan tan vruh iṅ paramatattva jinatva manda.</l>
.</lg>
.<lg n="3"><l n="a">nā deniraṅucapakən vacanopadeśa,</l>
.<l n="b">tan lambalamba tuhu yan jinamūrti sākṣāt,</l>
.<l n="c">durvaktra nāgapati sattvapati praṇamya,</l>
2330<l n="d">bhaktyātibhakti manaḍah vacanātiguhya.</l>
. <!-- <app>3a H. sə̄k de. — 3d H. bhaktyapranamya.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="4"><l n="a">sampun mateki ya kinonira bhikṣva vikva,</l>
2335<l n="b">yan kṣetra sindhu giri soṅgvanan iṅ mayega,</l>
.<l n="c">ṅhiṅ tan pakarvana tapovana hayva maṅkā,</l>
.<l n="d">yan maṅkaneka gati saṅ viku bauddhapakṣa.</l>
. <!-- <app>4d C. D. E. yan maṅhaneki.
.</app> -->
2340</lg>
.<lg n="5"><l n="a">nā liṅnirān tan ucapən ri gatinya rakva,</l>
.<l n="b">varṇan sireki təka riṅ giri merurāja,</l>
.<l n="c">ramyaṅ tapovana rikoṅgvan i saṅ hyaṅūni,</l>
.<l n="d">muṇḍisvabhāva sira yan makabuddhi śānta.</l>
2345</lg>
.<lg n="6"><l n="a">saṅ keśavarṣi masayut sira tan vikalpa,*</l>
.<l n="b">maṅkin kadhīran i manahnirāṅekacitta,**</l>
.<l n="c">nā hetu saṅ ṛṣi mulih sahamitra<app><lem>saṅgha</lem><rdg wit="#edss">saṅghya</rdg></app> ,</l>
.<l n="d">sampun sirojar i munīndra sumitra bauddha.</l>
2350 <!-- <app> * F. G. H. ** H.6a A. B. C. D. E. vekalpa. A. B. C. D. E. F. G. niranekacitta. H. sudhira i manah. s C. H. sirajar</app> -->
.</lg>
.
.</div>
.<div type="canto" rend="met" n="43" met="FILL-ME-IN">
2355<lg n="1"><l n="a">byātītan ri lavasnireṅ <app><lem>vana</lem><rdg wit="#edss">vaṇa</rdg></app> mahə̄m suragaṇa ṛṣi<app><lem>saṅgha</lem><rdg wit="#edss">saṅghya</rdg></app> varṇanən,</l>
.<l n="b">vrinvrin deni kaśaktiniṅ sudaśaputra ri patapa nareśvarātmaja,</l>
.<l n="c">māyā bañcana teki rakva gəlarən təkapira ri mahardhikeṅ manah,</l>
.<l n="d">donyān maryanirān nirāgrahanirāśrayan atəmaha bhūmipālaka.</l>
.</lg>
2360<lg n="2"><l n="a">nāhan hetuniraṅ surāpsaravadhū mareka paḍa kinon sureśvara,</l>
.<l n="b">mvaṅ sakvehnikanaṅ huvus kṛtayaśeṅ hayu maṅalahakən jitendriya,</l>
.<l n="c">prāptānəmbah i jə̄ṅ surendra luṅayanyan asəmu ləməs iṅ vəlasharəp,</l>
.<l n="d">tiṅhalnyāṅaravinda yāṅənani sə̄ṅ smita sahana lanāmaṅun lulut.</l>
. <!-- <app>2a H. yekā hetuniraṅ surāṅgana kinon marəka sahananiṅ kadevatan. — 2d H. kaṅinan asə̄ṅ smita.
2365</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="3"><l n="a">lvir mukṣān dinələ̄ vaneh pramukha saṅ sukiraṇa kalavan tilottama,</l>
.<l n="b">saṅ hyaṅ brahma sirātimarma lumihat vinaliṅ ira sarasvatīn marək,</l>
.<l n="c">hyaṅ śrī liṅ madhusūdanājarira yan ḍatəṅa təkap i kiṅkiṅ iṅ hati,</l>
2370<l n="d">devī śrī giriputri teki kahiḍəp paśupati təkap iṅ manah ləṅə̄ṅ.</l>
. <!-- <app>3a B. mukṣyān. — 3d H. ri hiḍəp paśupati.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="4"><l n="a">maṅkāṅ cittanireki rakva karuhun surapati sira teki gə̄ṅ lulut,</l>
2375<l n="b">hiṅanyān sutasoma liṅira bhaṭāra sira sama kəna prih aṅlare,</l>
.<l n="c">tan varṇan ri huvus surendra maməkasməkas i hayuni saṅ mamañcana,</l>
.<l n="d">sampun mamvit i jə̄ṅ purandara ta yāṅlarisakna saliṅ surādhipa.</l>
. <!-- <app>4d. i jə̄ṅ tripurusa.
.</app> -->
2380</lg>
.<lg n="5"><l n="a">taṅheh yan huniṅan lakunyan aməgat tavaṅ amuṅar i saṅhub iṅ laṅit,</l>
.<l n="b">lvir vintaṅ maṅalih parəṅ ri pakatonan* ika sumavur iṅ nabhastala,</l>
.<l n="c">və̄rnyānraṅ śarapuṣpa manmatha sakeṅ laras asəmu səkar səḍəṅ rurū,</l>
.<l n="d">morṇanūpura bhūṣaṇanya kuməñar kadi kilat alivə̄r iṅ ambara.</l>
2385 <!-- <app> * D. E. F. G. — 5a H. aməgat vana. — 5b A. B. C. H. pakaton.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="6"><l n="a">enjiṅ prāpta ri jə̄ṅnikaṅ giri tapovana maḍarat* i himbaṅ iṅ gəgər,</l>
.<l n="b">səṅkansəṅkan ikaṅ turunturunan iṅ juraṅ i havan ikāmaṅun ləṅə̄ṅ,</l>
2390<l n="c">kapvāhurhur anəñuh ambək aṅayuh səkar asana hanāṅayuh vuṅu,</l>
.<l n="d">len tekaṅ maṅayuh gaḍuṅ kalukaran tapih akiput avarṇa riṅ jinəm.</l>
. <!-- <app> * C. E. — 6a A. B. D. F. G. H. paḍarat. — 6b G. səṅkan ikaṅ. G. E. ikāmaṅun laṅə̄.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
2395<lg n="7"><l n="a">lumrāvra təka riṅ vanāvijavijah kavigaran i kalaṅvan iṅ səkar,</l>
.<l n="b">ləṅləṅ piṇḍanikaṅ vukir kadi kamānuṣan umulat i rūmnya vvah laṅə̄,</l>
.<l n="c">nirdon taṅ katira kəta deni manis iṅ laṭi masəmu pinəñcər iṅ guyu,</l>
.<l n="d">kumbaṅnyāṅrəṅih iṅ səkar hilaṅ i deni rəṅih ikana pet karājasan.</l>
. <!-- <app>7d C. ika pet.
2400</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="8"><l n="a">nyū dantārəja keṅineṅin asaput hima ri gəmuh ikaṅ payodhara,</l>
.<l n="b">moghārəsrəs ikaṅ vuluh gaḍiṅ aneka girimisən i gātraniṅ təṅah,</l>
.<l n="c">tan śobhaṅ ravi kevran aṅrəs i gəluṅnyan asəmu jaladāṅhəmu hudan,</l>
2405<l n="d">hyaṅ candrākucəm eraṅ iṅ dina təkapni mukhanikan amūrṇacandramā.</l>
. <!-- <app>8c B. G. śobhāṅarasi. D. śobhaṅrasi. E. śobhaṅrasa.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="9"><l n="a">gaṅgāṅhertali riṅ juraṅ svaranikān karuhuran i pataṅkis iṅ kale,</l>
2410<l n="b">meghāraṅraṅi riṅ tavaṅ riṅ apa yan kəna huləsakəneṅ acaṅkrama,</l>
.<l n="c">gəntər mandra munī dukilyan apəyəhpəyəh i sirat i denikāṅucap,</l>
.<l n="d">hrikniṅ sundari sinraṅ iṅ taṅis i deniṅ karabhasan* məneṅ jinəm.</l>
. <!-- <app> * H. — 9a H. karuhunan i. — 9d B. C. D. E. arabhasan. H. i polahan i karabhaṣan.
.</app> -->
2415</lg>
.<lg n="10"><l n="a">sakvehniṅ kalaṅə̄n paḍārəs avədi hajəṅ ika mukṣa riṅ səkar,</l>
.<l n="b">lvir hyaṅniṅ masa kārttikānurun i paṅjrahiṅ asana ri tambayiṅ kapāt,</l>
.<l n="c">len tekaṅ kadi campakāsəmu vilis ləṅəṅ araras arumpukan mənur,
.ñər tvasnyāsəmu rāga kāraṇa kaṅə̄naṅən i lulut i saṅ pakeṣṭinən.</l>
2420 <!-- <app>10c C. cāmpakāvilis. — 10d B. gə̄r tvas. E. kaṅə̄n i lulut.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="11"><l n="a">honyekaṅ hana riṅ śīlānayana riṅ vitiṅ asana sumaṇḍayaṅliga,</l>
.<l n="b">glānāmbəknika yan ruməṅvakən i kāstavani manisiraṅ nṛpātmaja,</l>
2425<l n="c">riṅ rūpādhika vijña sarvaguṇadhāraṇa vəkas iṅ inuttamottama,</l>
.<l n="d">yekāṅde rəsəp iṅ sakendran i tuvuhnira sahana rinəṅvarəṅvakən.</l>
.</lg>
.<lg n="12"><l n="a">kīrṇekaṅ maṅaraṅ vimohita savaṅ tinulisakən i luṅgah iṅ gaḍuṅ,</l>
.<l n="b">ləṅləṅ lvir hinaveśa riṅ smara kadīṅ ulahulahiṅ akuṅ kəneṅ hunəṅ,</l>
2430<l n="c">dudvekaṅ mahaṅan hanān kadi huvus vruh i sira kadi kadyanuṅsuṅa,</l>
.<l n="d">cət len taṅ katəkan haripnya təka riṅ svapna kadi katon sumaṇḍiṅa.</l>
. <!-- <app>12a B. kirṇneka. — 12b B. D. E. hinaveṣa riṅ smara kadīnulah-ulah.
.</app> -->
.</lg>
2435<lg n="13"><l n="a">vvantən lvir silumaṇ ḍatəṅ kadi tulis vahu pinəpəs aṅambvakən raras,</l>
.<l n="b">ṅkāne yaśa* ri himbaṅ iṅ juraṅ aṅuṅkuli bañu tuməḍun sakeṅ vukir,</l>
.<l n="c">tan ryamban gumuliṅ mahāṅisisakən təṅah anuriga kabvatan susu,</l>
.<l n="d">tan śobhāṅlihanan sumuṅkəm i karaṅhulu ləṅəṅ amarantyakən taṅis.</l>
. <!-- <app> * B. C. D. E. F. G. H. — 13b A. hyāśa.
2440</app> -->
.</lg>
.<lg n="14"><l n="a">ceṭinyāglar aneka riṅ natar apet raras araupu səkar telas rurū,</l>
